title: About Us
description: Learn about Optometric Cafe, a family-owned Beverly Hills optometry boutique offering eye exams, prescription eyewear, contact lenses, and designer sunglasses.
content:
Since 2005, Optometric Cafe has been proudly owned and operated by Morteza Talebi and his family in the heart of Beverly Hills. As a master optician with decades of experience, Morteza personally oversees every aspect of your eye care—from precise vision testing to expert lens crafting in our on-site lab. We provide comprehensive eye exams, precision prescription lenses, and a curated collection of designer eyewear and luxury sunglasses for men, women, and children.

As a family-owned optical boutique, we believe in building lasting relationships with our patients. Morteza and our team of skilled optometrists and opticians guide you through the latest advancements in lens technology, frame design, and vision care. Our eyewear selection features world-class designers including Persol, Salt, Oliver Peoples, Chanel, Prada, Paul Smith, Tom Ford, Lunor, SwissFlex, Anglo American, Maui Jim, Ray-Ban, Liberty Sport, Alain Mikli, Kawasaki Kids, 2.5 Eyewear Kids, Victory Collection, Prodesign Denmark, Mykita, Eye-bobs, Velocity, Ray-Ban Jr. and select vintage frames. Each pair—glasses or sunglasses—is chosen for style, durability, and superior optical performance.

Family-Owned Beverly Hills Optometrist & Designer Eyewear Boutique

Our Story & Philosophy

Optometric Cafe was founded with a simple mission: combine exceptional eye care with a welcoming, boutique shopping experience. For nearly two decades, Morteza Talebi has personally fitted thousands of patients, bringing unmatched craftsmanship and attention to detail. Unlike chain optical stores, every adjustment, lens choice, and style recommendation comes from an experienced professional who knows your unique needs. Our goal is simple—to help you see better and look your best.

Our Sunglasses Expertise

We’re a leading destination for luxury sunglasses in Beverly Hills. From timeless aviators to bold, fashion-forward frames, our selection includes both prescription and non-prescription sunglasses from designers like Maui Jim, Oliver Peoples, Ray-Ban, Mykita, and Tom Ford. We specialize in polarized lenses for superior glare reduction and high-performance options for active lifestyles. Whether you’re strolling down Rodeo Drive or spending the weekend outdoors, we’ll help you find sunglasses that protect your eyes and reflect your personal style.

Comprehensive Eye Care Services

Our services go beyond selling glasses. We offer comprehensive eye exams, early detection of vision and eye-health issues, and expert guidance on the best optical solutions for your needs. With our in-house optical laboratory, we craft even the most complex prescriptions with speed and precision. From progressive lenses to contact lenses and computer eyewear, every product uses high-quality lens materials and coatings. Explore our latest sunglasses collection and prescription glasses in store.

Why Choose a Family-Owned Beverly Hills Optometrist?

At Optometric Cafe, you’re never just another appointment. Morteza and our team take the time to understand your lifestyle and vision goals. Being family-owned means we offer flexible, personalized service—whether that’s rushing an order for a special event or sourcing a rare designer frame just for you. Many of our patients have been with us for years, bringing their children and even grandchildren for care. Read more about our commitment to quality.

Visit Us on South Beverly Drive

Located just minutes from Rodeo Drive, our boutique is easy to reach from anywhere in Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, and Century City. Contact us to browse our eyewear collections, book a thorough eye exam, or get expert adjustments to your current glasses. Appointments are recommended for exams to ensure dedicated time with our optometrist. Contact us today to schedule your visit.

Find Your Perfect Glasses Today

Whether you’re looking for prescription eyeglasses, stylish sunglasses, or a custom fit for your unique face shape, Optometric Cafe is here to help. Explore our handpicked selection of designer frames and let Morteza guide you to eyewear you’ll truly love.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

For nearly two decades, Morteza Talebi has personally fitted thousands of patients, bringing unmatched craftsmanship and attention to detail. Unlike chain optical stores, every adjustment, lens choice, and style recommendation comes from an experienced professional who knows your unique needs. Our goal is simple—to help you see better and look your best. Our Sunglasses Expertise We’re a leading destination for luxury sunglasses in Beverly Hills. From timeless aviators to bold, fashion-forward frames, our selection includes both prescription and non-prescription sunglasses from designers like Maui Jim, Oliver Peoples, Ray-Ban, Mykita, and Tom Ford. We specialize in polarized lenses for superior glare reduction and high-performance options for active lifestyles. Whether you’re strolling down Rodeo Drive or spending the weekend outdoors, we’ll help you find sunglasses that protect your eyes and reflect your personal style. Comprehensive Eye Care Services Our services go beyond selling glasses. We offer comprehensive eye exams, early detection of vision and eye-health issues, and expert guidance on the best optical solutions for your needs. With our in-house optical laboratory, we craft even the most complex prescriptions with speed and precision. From progressive lenses to contact lenses and computer eyewear, every product uses high-quality lens materials and coatings. Explore our latest sunglasses collection and prescription glasses in store. Why Choose a Family-Owned Beverly Hills Optometrist? At Optometric Cafe, you’re never just another appointment. Morteza and our team take the time to understand your lifestyle and vision goals. Many of our patients have been with us for years, bringing their children and even grandchildren for care. Read more about our commitment to quality. Visit Us on South Beverly Drive Located just minutes from Rodeo Drive, our boutique is easy to reach from anywhere in Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, and Century City. Contact us to browse our eyewear collections, book a thorough eye exam, or get expert adjustments to your current glasses. Appointments are recommended for exams to ensure dedicated time with our optometrist. Contact us today to schedule your visit. title: Blog
Children’s Prescription Glasses
description: Shop children’s prescription glasses in Beverly Hills with durable frames, comfortable fittings, and patient guidance for growing kids.
content:
CHILDREN’S PRESCRIPTION GLASSES

Finding great glasses for your child doesn’t have to be stressful. At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we make it easy (and fun) with a handpicked collection of durable, comfortable, and stylish frames that kids love to wear. From playful plastics to mini versions of grown-up favorites, every frame on our shelves is chosen with real life in mind—school, play, and everything in between.

Parents tell us they appreciate our family-owned approach and on-site lens lab for quick, precise prescriptions—including complex cases. And kids? They love walking out with glasses that feel good, look cool, and fit their personality. You’ll get honest guidance (never pushy), careful fittings, and lenses crafted right here in Beverly Hills.

Why Beverly Hills Parents Choose Optometric Cafe

  • Bespoke kids’ selection: Frames handpicked by Morteza—from classic tortoise and sleek titanium to bright, playful acetates.
  • Built for real life: Flexible hinges, comfortable bridges, and strong materials that stand up to school and play.
  • On-site lab precision: Custom lenses made in our own Beverly Hills lab for speed, accuracy, and consistent quality.
  • Complex prescriptions welcome: High powers, astigmatism, prism, progressives—handled with care and experience.
  • Warm, not-pushy fittings: We match frames to face shape, personality, and daily routine so kids actually enjoy wearing them.

Frames Kids Actually Want to Wear

Kids want glasses that look like the people they admire—parents, siblings, friends, or favorite styles they’ve spotted. Our curated assortment makes it easy to find a look that feels “so them,” whether that’s a tiny retro oval, a sporty wrap feel in a durable everyday frame, or a chic, scaled-down cat-eye. Because we’re a boutique (not a big-box wall of sameness), you’ll find unique pieces with better materials and more thoughtful design.

  • Durable plastics: Lightweight, comfy, and available in colors kids love.
  • Flexible, sport-friendly options: Rubberized details and bend-back hinges that help prevent breakage.
  • Titanium: Featherlight, hypoallergenic, and tough—great for sensitive skin or all-day wear.
  • Mini “grown-up” styles: Popular adult looks, scaled to fit small faces beautifully.

Custom Lenses Made in Our On-Site Lab

Your child’s prescription is crafted right here in our Beverly Hills lab—no shipping to a distant warehouse. That means faster turnaround, tighter quality control, and the ability to solve tricky prescriptions that many stores won’t touch. We’ll recommend the right lens design for comfort and clarity now, and we’ll keep measurements on file to make updates simple as your child grows.

  • Impact-resistant materials (polycarbonate/Trivex): Safer for school and sports.
  • Blue-light comfort: Options that help reduce digital eye strain for homework and screens.
  • Anti-reflective and scratch-resistant coatings: Clearer vision, easier cleaning, longer wear.
  • Transitions (light-adaptive): Convenience for sunny playgrounds and after-school activities.
  • Progressives/bifocals (when prescribed): Seamless near-to-far vision for specific needs.

Gentle, Personalized Fittings

Every face is different. Bridge fit, temple length, pantoscopic tilt, and pupillary alignment all matter—especially for children. We adjust frames on the spot and make sure the lenses align precisely with your child’s visual center. Morteza’s calm, friendly approach helps kids relax and enjoy the process; parents appreciate the attention to detail and straightforward guidance.

Style + Protection: Sunglasses for Kids

For outdoor time in Beverly Hills and around Los Angeles, we strongly recommend children’s sunglasses with 100% UV protection. We can craft prescription sunglasses in your child’s favorite style, or add clip-on sun lenses for select frames. For sports, ask us about wrap styles and retention options that stay put in motion.

Made for School, Sports, and Weekends

We’ll help you choose a pair (or two) that fits your child’s week. Many families pick an everyday “school” pair and a second pair for sports or the playground. If your child plays contact or ball sports, we’ll guide you toward safer, impact-resistant options that meet activity demands without sacrificing comfort or style.

Local, Family-Owned, and Here When You Need Us

Optometric Cafe is proudly family-owned in South Beverly Hills, convenient to Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. We keep your child’s measurements and prescription history on file for easy updates, quick fixes, or reorders. If a nose pad needs adjusting or frames need a tune-up after a lively weekend—stop in. We’re happy to help.

Shopping Tips for Parents

  • Let them choose (with guidance): When kids love the look, they wear them more.
  • Prioritize fit first: A comfy bridge and proper frame width matter more than anything.
  • Ask about coatings: AR and scratch-resistance make daily wear easier and clearer.
  • Plan for growth: We can re-adjust as needed and advise on when it’s time to size up or refresh.
  • Consider a second pair: One for school, one for sports, or a dedicated backup for peace of mind.

FAQs: Children’s Prescription Glasses

How fast can you make my child’s lenses?
Because we craft lenses in our on-site lab, most standard prescriptions are ready quickly. Complex prescriptions may take a little longer—we’ll give you a clear timeline during your fitting.
What frame materials are best for active kids?
Durable plastics and flexible, rubberized designs are parent favorites. Titanium is ultra-light and strong for all-day comfort. We’ll match materials to your child’s routine.
Do you handle difficult prescriptions?
Yes. Our lab regularly produces high powers, astigmatism corrections, prism, and progressives for kids when prescribed. We’ll explain options and set expectations clearly.
Should my child get blue-light protection?
For kids on tablets or laptops, blue-light comfort coatings can help reduce digital eye strain. We’ll recommend what makes sense based on age and screen time.
Do you offer prescription sunglasses for kids?
Absolutely. We can craft prescription sunglasses in many children’s frames, or provide clip-on sun lenses for select models.

If your child also needs contact lenses for sports or special occasions, we can help with that, too. Visit our contact lenses page or ask during your fitting.

Helpful Guides for Parents

Parents may also want to read our guides to kids prescription glasses fit and durability, how often children should get eye exams, and screen-related eye strain.

Book Your Child’s Glasses Fitting in Beverly Hills

Help your child see clearly and feel confident with children’s prescription glasses crafted in our on-site lab. Call (310) 888-2848 or book online to schedule your visit. We’ll make it easy, friendly, and precise.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

prescription is crafted right here in our Beverly Hills lab—no shipping to a distant warehouse. That means faster turnaround, tighter quality control, and the ability to solve tricky prescriptions that many stores won’t touch. We’ll recommend the right lens design for comfort and clarity now, and we’ll keep measurements on file to make updates simple as your child grows. Impact-resistant materials (polycarbonate/Trivex): Safer for school and sports. Blue-light comfort: Options that help reduce digital eye strain for homework and screens. Anti-reflective and scratch-resistant coatings: Clearer vision, easier cleaning, longer wear. Transitions (light-adaptive): Convenience for sunny playgrounds and after-school activities. Progressives/bifocals (when prescribed): Seamless near-to-far vision for specific needs. Gentle, Personalized Fittings Every face is different. Bridge fit, temple length, pantoscopic tilt, and pupillary alignment all matter—especially for children. We adjust frames on the spot and make sure the lenses align precisely with your child’s visual center. Morteza’s calm, friendly approach helps kids relax and enjoy the process; parents appreciate the attention to detail and straightforward guidance. Style + Protection: Sunglasses for Kids For outdoor time in Beverly Hills and around Los Angeles, we strongly recommend children’s sunglasses with 100% UV protection. We can craft prescription sunglasses in your child’s favorite style, or add clip-on sun lenses for select frames. For sports, ask us about wrap styles and retention options that stay put in motion. Made for School, Sports, and Weekends We’ll help you choose a pair (or two) that fits your child’s week. Many families pick an everyday “school” pair and a second pair for sports or the playground. If your child plays contact or ball sports, we’ll guide you toward safer, impact-resistant options that meet activity demands without sacrificing comfort or style. Local, Family-Owned, and Here When You Need Us Optometric Cafe is proudly family-owned in South Beverly Hills, convenient to Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. We keep your child’s measurements and prescription history on file for easy updates, quick fixes, or reorders. If a nose pad needs adjusting or frames need a tune-up after a lively weekend—stop in. We’re happy to help. Shopping Tips for Parents Let them choose (with guidance): When kids love the look, they wear them more. Prioritize fit first: A comfy bridge and proper frame width matter more than anything. Ask about coatings: AR and scratch-resistance make daily wear easier and clearer. Plan for growth: We can re-adjust as needed and advise on when it’s time to size up or refresh. Consider a second pair: One for school, one for sports, or a dedicated backup for peace of mind. FAQs: Children’s Prescription Glasses How fast can you make my child’s lenses? Because we craft lenses in our on-site lab, most standard prescriptions are ready quickly. Complex prescriptions may take a little longer—we’ll give you a clear timeline during your fitting. What frame materials are best for active kids? Durable plastics and flexible, rubberized designs are parent favorites. Titanium is ultra-light and strong for all-day comfort. We’ll match materials to your child’s routine. Do you handle difficult prescriptions? Yes. Our lab regularly produces high powers, astigmatism corrections, prism, and progressives for kids when prescribed. We’ll explain options and set expectations clearly. Should my child get blue-light protection? For kids on tablets or laptops, blue-light comfort coatings can help reduce digital eye strain. We’ll recommend what makes sense based on age and screen time. Do you offer prescription sunglasses for kids? Absolutely. We can craft prescription sunglasses in many children’s frames, or provide clip-on sun lenses for select models. If your child also needs contact lenses for sports or special occasions, we can help with that, too. Visit our contact lenses page or ask during your fitting. title: Children’s Sunglasses in Beverly Hills (Prescription Options, Too)
description: Find children’s sunglasses in Beverly Hills, including prescription kids sunglasses, comfortable fittings, durable frames, and UV protection.
content:
CHILDREN’S SUNGLASSES IN BEVERLY HILLS (PRESCRIPTION OPTIONS, TOO)

Kids love to look like Mom, Dad, and older siblings — and we love helping them do it safely. At Optometric Cafe, our children’s sunglasses include prescription options with impact-resistant lenses and 100% UV protection, fitted by our family optician, Morteza.

From cool, “just-like-the-grownups” shapes to colorful, sporty frames, we carry styles kids actually want to wear —and wear consistently. Visit our Beverly Hills boutique to explore options and get a comfortable, secure fit.

FASHIONABLE AND SHOCK RESISTANT SUNGLASSES TOO

We’ve curated a cheerful, durable collection of kids’ sunglasses so families can find styles that feel fun for children and reassuring for parents. Think oval, round, rectangular, cat-eye, and geometric silhouettes in easy-to-match colors like green, blue, tortoise, and black — plus sporty wraparounds that mirror trendy adult looks. When needed, we craft prescription sunglasses in-house for crisp, comfortable vision outdoors.

Why Children’s Sunglasses Matter (Without the Lecture)

Kids spend more time outside than most adults — playgrounds, sports, beach days, and school outings — so a reliable pair of UV-blocking sunglasses quickly becomes part of everyday life. Because young eyes filter light differently, we take extra care with lens materials and coatings to protect against UV and high-energy visible (HEV) light while keeping things lightweight and comfy.

Our goal is simple: make sunglasses kids want to wear, with the protection parents expect.

Comfortable Fits Kids Will Actually Wear

Frames they’ll love

  • “Mini-me” adult-style frames (always a hit for tweens).
  • Bright, modern plastics in rich colors and soft-touch finishes.
  • Sporty wraparounds for playgrounds and weekend games.
  • Flexible temples and adjustable bridges for growing faces.

Protection you’ll trust

  • 100% UVA/UVB protection across our children’s range.
  • Impact-resistant polycarbonate or Trivex® lenses for safety.
  • Optional polarization to reduce glare for driving with parents, beach, and sports.
  • Scratch-resistant and easy-clean coatings for daily use.

Prescription Sunglasses for Kids (Made Right Here)

If your child wears glasses, prescription sunglasses make outdoor time easier and safer. We’ll match their current Rx and build lenses in our own optometry lab for clear optics and a secure, child-friendly fit. Choose from single-vision or specialty options (like accommodative support), add polarized lenses for glare, and finish with coatings that stand up to school life.

  • Rx verification and measurements performed in-boutique by Morteza.
  • Comfort adjustments, nose-pads, and temple tweaks on the spot.
  • Repairs and re-fits as your child grows — we’re here long after pickup.

Popular Styles Kids Ask For

  • Cool, sophisticated “adult” looks (mini aviators, slim rectangles, subtle cat-eye).
  • Modern plastic styles with matte finishes and rich colorways.
  • Scaled-down sport frames that hug and stay put.
  • Clip-on and magnetic sun shields for children’s prescription glasses.
  • Trusted brand appeal (we keep it curated and age-appropriate).

Need an updated prescription? Book a friendly eye check first and we’ll guide you from start to finish —
exam, frames, and lenses. Learn more about our eye exams & optometry services, or explore prescription glasses,
contact lenses, and prescription sunglasses for the whole family.

Our Family Boutique Difference

Optometric Cafe is a family-owned practice in Beverly Hills. You’ll meet Morteza, our optician, who fits every pair personally and makes sure your child feels comfortable and confident. We don’t rush, we don’t upsell, and we’re happy to answer every question. Get to know us on our About Us page, then stop by to see the collection in person.

We don’t sell online — we believe children’s eyewear deserves an in-person fitting. Visit our boutique: 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212. Call (310) 888-2848.

FAQs: Children’s Sunglasses

Do kids really need sunglasses?
Yes. Reliable UV protection helps safeguard developing eyes during outdoor play, sports, and family outings.
What’s the best lens material for kids?
Polycarbonate or Trivex® — both are impact-resistant, lightweight, and ideal for active kids.
Should we choose polarized lenses?
Polarization reduces glare (great for car rides, beach, and sports). We’ll advise based on your child’s routine.
My child already wears glasses — can we do prescription sunglasses?
Absolutely. We’ll match the current Rx and craft prescription sunglasses in our in-house lab.
How do you keep sunglasses from slipping?
We adjust bridges and temples in-boutique and can add gentle retention straps for sports and younger kids.
Can we get clip-ons for their regular glasses?
Yes, we carry clip-ons and magnetic shields that fit select children’s frames.

Helpful Guides for Families

Families can also review kids prescription glasses fit and durability, sports glasses and active sunglasses, and prescription sunglasses vs regular sunglasses.

Book Your Children’s Sunglasses Fitting in Beverly Hills

Keep young eyes safe with kids’ sunglasses that block 100% of harmful UV rays. From colorful frames to mini versions of trendy adult styles, we’ll help your child find the perfect fit. Visit our Beverly Hills boutique or call (310) 888-2848 today.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

header_2_text_align=”left”] We’ve curated a cheerful, durable collection of kids’ sunglasses so families can find styles that feel fun for children and reassuring for parents. Think oval, round, rectangular, cat-eye, and geometric silhouettes in easy-to-match colors like green, blue, tortoise, and black — plus sporty wraparounds that mirror trendy adult looks. When needed, we craft prescription sunglasses in-house for crisp, comfortable vision outdoors. Why Children’s Sunglasses Matter (Without the Lecture) Kids spend more time outside than most adults — playgrounds, sports, beach days, and school outings — so a reliable pair of UV-blocking sunglasses quickly becomes part of everyday life. Because young eyes filter light differently, we take extra care with lens materials and coatings to protect against UV and high-energy visible (HEV) light while keeping things lightweight and comfy. Our goal is simple: make sunglasses kids want to wear, with the protection parents expect. Comfortable Fits Kids Will Actually Wear Frames they’ll love “Mini-me” adult-style frames (always a hit for tweens). Bright, modern plastics in rich colors and soft-touch finishes. Sporty wraparounds for playgrounds and weekend games. Flexible temples and adjustable bridges for growing faces. Protection you’ll trust 100% UVA/UVB protection across our children’s range. Impact-resistant polycarbonate or Trivex® lenses for safety. Optional polarization to reduce glare for driving with parents, beach, and sports. Scratch-resistant and easy-clean coatings for daily use. Prescription Sunglasses for Kids (Made Right Here) If your child wears glasses, prescription sunglasses make outdoor time easier and safer. We’ll match their current Rx and build lenses in our own optometry lab for clear optics and a secure, child-friendly fit. Choose from single-vision or specialty options (like accommodative support), add polarized lenses for glare, and finish with coatings that stand up to school life. Rx verification and measurements performed in-boutique by Morteza. Comfort adjustments, nose-pads, and temple tweaks on the spot. Repairs and re-fits as your child grows — we’re here long after pickup. Popular Styles Kids Ask For Cool, sophisticated “adult” looks (mini aviators, slim rectangles, subtle cat-eye). Modern plastic styles with matte finishes and rich colorways. Scaled-down sport frames that hug and stay put. Clip-on and magnetic sun shields for children’s prescription glasses. Trusted brand appeal (we keep it curated and age-appropriate). Need an updated prescription? Book a friendly eye check first and we’ll guide you from start to finish —exam, frames, and lenses. Learn more about our eye exams & optometry services, or explore prescription glasses,contact lenses, and prescription sunglasses for the whole family. Our Family Boutique Difference Optometric Cafe is a family-owned practice in Beverly Hills. You’ll meet Morteza, our optician, who fits every pair personally and makes sure your child feels comfortable and confident. We don’t rush, we don’t upsell, and we’re happy to answer every question. Get to know us on our About Us page, then stop by to see the collection in person. We don’t sell online — we believe children’s eyewear deserves an in-person fitting. Visit our boutique: 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212. Call (310) 888-2848. FAQs: Children’s Sunglasses Do kids really need sunglasses? Yes. Reliable UV protection helps safeguard developing eyes during outdoor play, sports, and family outings. What’s the best lens material for kids? Polycarbonate or Trivex® — both are impact-resistant, lightweight, and ideal for active kids. Should we choose polarized lenses? Polarization reduces glare (great for car rides, beach, and sports). We’ll advise based on your child’s routine. My child already wears glasses — can we do prescription sunglasses? Absolutely. We’ll match the current Rx and craft prescription sunglasses in our in-house lab. How do you keep sunglasses from slipping? We adjust bridges and temples in-boutique and can add gentle retention straps for sports and younger kids. Can we get clip-ons for their regular glasses? Yes, we carry clip-ons and magnetic shields that fit select children’s frames. title: Computer & Gaming Glasses in Beverly Hills
description: Reduce digital eye strain with computer and gaming glasses in Beverly Hills, including blue-light lens options and custom prescription eyewear.
content:
Computer & Gaming Glasses in Beverly Hills

Hours on screens shouldn’t leave your eyes tired. At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we make computer and gaming glasses that feel great to wear and help you stay comfortable—whether you’re working, studying, editing, streaming, or gaming late with friends.

We offer well-known options like GUNNAR along with custom computer lenses crafted in our on-site laboratory. Morteza handpicks frames for comfort under headsets and long desk days, then we fine-tune lenses for your screen setup and distance. Friendly guidance, precise fits, never pushy.

Why Choose Computer or Gaming Glasses?

Modern work and play happen on screens. Computer and gaming glasses are designed to support the way you actually use your eyes—extended viewing at one to three feet, shifting focus between monitors, chats, and notes, and staying comfortable under bright indoor lighting. The right lenses can ease digital eye strain, reduce glare, sharpen contrast, and help you maintain better posture by letting your eyes relax at your true working distance.

Two Great Paths: GUNNAR or Custom Lab Lenses

We carry GUNNAR computer eyewear for customers who prefer a brand with purpose-built designs and contrast-enhancing tints. We also build custom computer lenses in your favorite frame—single-vision for a fixed distance, or office/desk progressives that give you a generous intermediate zone for multiple screens plus a comfortable near area for documents. Not sure what you need? We’ll try lens samples and dial in the working distance that matches your setup.

Lens Features That Make a Difference

  • Anti-reflective coatings: Cut harsh glare from overheads and screens so text looks crisp and eyes feel calmer on video calls.
  • Blue-light comfort options: Select from clear AR coatings that reduce screen glare or light-amber tints that gently boost contrast. We’ll match the choice to your job, color-accuracy needs, and environment.
  • Office/desk progressives: For multi-monitor or laptop-plus-doc workflows, these lenses maximize the intermediate zone so you’re not craning forward to see clearly.
  • Prescription accuracy: From plano to complex prescriptions, we center and calibrate lenses for your exact viewing distance so your eyes can relax naturally.
  • Optional wrap & coverage: Certain designs reduce airflow around the eyes, which can help with dryness in AC or heated rooms.

GUNNAR at Optometric Cafe

Many customers appreciate GUNNAR’s purpose-built designs for extended screen time. Select models feature wrapped profiles, tints that enhance contrast, and lens geometries aimed at easier focusing at computer distance. If you’re curious, we’ll have you try GUNNAR side-by-side with our custom lens options so you can feel the difference and pick what’s most comfortable for your eyes and your workflow.

Custom Lenses From Our On-Site Lab

Because we craft lenses in our Beverly Hills lab, you get faster turnaround and tighter quality control than mail-out shops. We regularly handle high prescriptions, astigmatism, and fine alignment work for office and gaming use. Want to duplicate your exact chair-to-monitor distance? Bring a quick measurement or photo of your setup and we’ll optimize the focal point so your posture stays natural and your eyes relax.

Frames Handpicked by Morteza

Comfort is everything for long sessions. Morteza curates frames that are light, stable, and headset-friendly—think slimmer temples that sit neatly under headphones, silicone nose pads that stay put, and materials that hold adjustment. Whether you prefer understated minimalism or a bolder statement, you’ll find not-run-of-the-mill styles that look sharp on camera and feel good all day.

For Gamers: Comfort, Focus, Endurance

Gaming puts unique demands on your eyes and posture. We’ll tune lenses for your primary screen distance and preferred seating, consider a light contrast tint if you like, and make sure your frame plays nicely with your headset. If you’re sensitive to room airflow or AC, we can explore slightly more wrapped designs to help keep eyes comfortable during long sessions.

For Work & Study: Clarity and Posture

Office and study setups are rarely one-size-fits-all. If you switch between a laptop, a second display, and print materials, office/desk progressives can reduce the urge to hunch toward the screen. Prefer a single-vision computer pair? We’ll set the focal length for your exact desk distance so your neck and shoulders can relax while you keep text crisp across your primary monitor.

Dry-Eye & Bright-Light Considerations

Staring at screens reduces blink rate, and HVAC can make dryness worse. Lenses with excellent AR coatings, frames with stable fit, and modest wrap or side coverage can all help. We’ll walk you through practical comfort choices—from lens finish to frame geometry—so your eyes feel better at the end of the day.

Prescription, Turnaround & Insurance

We build both non-prescription and prescription computer lenses. Because production happens in our lab, most standard jobs are ready quickly; complex designs may take a bit longer. We’ll outline timing at your fitting. If you’re using vision benefits, bring your details and we’ll help you understand eligible options.

Local & Family-Owned

Optometric Cafe is a family-owned boutique on South Beverly Drive, serving Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. We keep your measurements and preferences on file, adjust frames anytime, and help you evolve your computer eyewear as your setup or role changes.

FAQs: Computer & Gaming Glasses

Do I need blue-light filtering?
Many people find comfort benefits from glare reduction and select blue-light options, especially under bright LEDs or at night. We’ll recommend a clear AR or light-amber approach based on your color-accuracy needs and environment.
Are GUNNAR lenses available with my prescription?
We can review current availability and, if needed, craft custom prescription computer lenses in your preferred frame with similar comfort goals.
What’s the difference between office/desk progressives and regular progressives?
Office/desk designs expand the intermediate zone used for screens and reduce the far-distance area. They’re great if most of your day is at arm’s length with occasional near work.
How long will my glasses take?
Because we fabricate lenses in our on-site lab, standard jobs are ready quickly; specialized designs may take longer. We’ll give you a clear timeline at your fitting.
Will these help with headaches and eye strain?
By aligning lenses to your true working distance and reducing reflections and glare, many people experience less strain. We’ll tailor the solution to your setup for the best comfort.

Exploring eyewear for every part of your week? Visit our pages for prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, and sports glasses. If you wear contacts, see contact lenses for screen-friendly fits.

Related Screen Comfort Guides

Read our guides to computer glasses for digital eye strain, how often to get an eye exam, and contact lens comfort and fitting.

Book Your Computer & Gaming Glasses Fitting

Feel the difference of lenses tuned to your screen distance and workflow. Try GUNNAR and our custom lab lenses side-by-side at Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills. Call (310) 888-2848 or book online to get started.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

box_shadow_blur_tablet=”40px” box_shadow_spread_tablet=”0px” divienhancer_set=”none” divienhancer_hover_effect=”none” z_index_tablet=”500″ text_text_align=”left”] Why Choose Computer or Gaming Glasses? Modern work and play happen on screens. Computer and gaming glasses are designed to support the way you actually use your eyes—extended viewing at one to three feet, shifting focus between monitors, chats, and notes, and staying comfortable under bright indoor lighting. The right lenses can ease digital eye strain, reduce glare, sharpen contrast, and help you maintain better posture by letting your eyes relax at your true working distance. Two Great Paths: GUNNAR or Custom Lab Lenses We carry GUNNAR computer eyewear for customers who prefer a brand with purpose-built designs and contrast-enhancing tints. We also build custom computer lenses in your favorite frame—single-vision for a fixed distance, or office/desk progressives that give you a generous intermediate zone for multiple screens plus a comfortable near area for documents. Not sure what you need? We’ll try lens samples and dial in the working distance that matches your setup. Lens Features That Make a Difference Anti-reflective coatings: Cut harsh glare from overheads and screens so text looks crisp and eyes feel calmer on video calls. Blue-light comfort options: Select from clear AR coatings that reduce screen glare or light-amber tints that gently boost contrast. We’ll match the choice to your job, color-accuracy needs, and environment. Office/desk progressives: For multi-monitor or laptop-plus-doc workflows, these lenses maximize the intermediate zone so you’re not craning forward to see clearly. Prescription accuracy: From plano to complex prescriptions, we center and calibrate lenses for your exact viewing distance so your eyes can relax naturally. Optional wrap & coverage: Certain designs reduce airflow around the eyes, which can help with dryness in AC or heated rooms. GUNNAR at Optometric Cafe Many customers appreciate GUNNAR’s purpose-built designs for extended screen time. Select models feature wrapped profiles, tints that enhance contrast, and lens geometries aimed at easier focusing at computer distance. If you’re curious, we’ll have you try GUNNAR side-by-side with our custom lens options so you can feel the difference and pick what’s most comfortable for your eyes and your workflow. Custom Lenses From Our On-Site Lab Because we craft lenses in our Beverly Hills lab, you get faster turnaround and tighter quality control than mail-out shops. We regularly handle high prescriptions, astigmatism, and fine alignment work for office and gaming use. Want to duplicate your exact chair-to-monitor distance? Bring a quick measurement or photo of your setup and we’ll optimize the focal point so your posture stays natural and your eyes relax. Frames Handpicked by Morteza Comfort is everything for long sessions. Morteza curates frames that are light, stable, and headset-friendly—think slimmer temples that sit neatly under headphones, silicone nose pads that stay put, and materials that hold adjustment. Whether you prefer understated minimalism or a bolder statement, you’ll find not-run-of-the-mill styles that look sharp on camera and feel good all day. For Gamers: Comfort, Focus, Endurance Gaming puts unique demands on your eyes and posture. We’ll tune lenses for your primary screen distance and preferred seating, consider a light contrast tint if you like, and make sure your frame plays nicely with your headset. If you’re sensitive to room airflow or AC, we can explore slightly more wrapped designs to help keep eyes comfortable during long sessions. For Work & Study: Clarity and Posture Office and study setups are rarely one-size-fits-all. If you switch between a laptop, a second display, and print materials, office/desk progressives can reduce the urge to hunch toward the screen. Prefer a single-vision computer pair? We’ll set the focal length for your exact desk distance so your neck and shoulders can relax while you keep text crisp across your primary monitor. Dry-Eye & Bright-Light Considerations Staring at screens reduces blink rate, and HVAC can make dryness worse. Lenses with excellent AR coatings, frames with stable fit, and modest wrap or side coverage can all help. We’ll walk you through practical comfort choices—from lens finish to frame geometry—so your eyes feel better at the end of the day. Prescription, Turnaround & Insurance We build both non-prescription and prescription computer lenses. Because production happens in our lab, most standard jobs are ready quickly; complex designs may take a bit longer. We’ll outline timing at your fitting. If you’re using vision benefits, bring your details and we’ll help you understand eligible options. Local & Family-Owned Optometric Cafe is a family-owned boutique on South Beverly Drive, serving Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. We keep your measurements and preferences on file, adjust frames anytime, and help you evolve your computer eyewear as your setup or role changes. Do I need blue-light filtering? Many people find comfort benefits from glare reduction and select blue-light options, especially under bright LEDs or at night. We’ll recommend a clear AR or light-amber approach based on your color-accuracy needs and environment. Are GUNNAR lenses available with my prescription? We can review current availability and, if needed, craft custom prescription computer lenses in your preferred frame with similar comfort goals. What’s the difference between office/desk progressives and regular progressives? Office/desk designs expand the intermediate zone used for screens and reduce the far-distance area. They’re great if most of your day is at arm’s length with occasional near work. How long will my glasses take? Because we fabricate lenses in our on-site lab, standard jobs are ready quickly; specialized designs may take longer. We’ll give you a clear timeline at your fitting. Will these help with headaches and eye strain? By aligning lenses to your true working distance and reducing reflections and glare, many people experience less strain. We’ll tailor the solution to your setup for the best comfort. Exploring eyewear for every part of your week? Visit our pages for prescription eyeglasses, sunglasses, and sports glasses. If you wear contacts, see contact lenses for screen-friendly fits. title: Contact Lenses in Beverly Hills
description: Get contact lenses in Beverly Hills with professional fittings, prescription options, and personalized guidance for daily, monthly, toric, and multifocal lenses.
content:
CONTACT LENSES IN BEVERLY HILLS

Contact Lenses in Beverly Hills

Finding the right contact lenses isn’t just about convenience — it’s about comfort, safety, and professional care. At Optometric Cafe, we make the process easy and reliable. Our optician, Morteza, helps you choose and fit the best lenses for your prescription and lifestyle, while our in-office ophthalmologist is available for comprehensive eye exams and prescription updates.

Once your prescription is verified, we order directly from trusted manufacturers such as Acuvue, Ciba Vision, and Bausch + Lomb, and have your lenses ready for pickup in our Beverly Hills boutique.

Why Choose Professional Contact Lens Care?

Ordering contact lenses online can seem simple, but without proper fitting and guidance, you risk dryness, irritation, or long-term eye damage. At Optometric Cafe, we combine medical oversight with boutique service to give you the best of both worlds:

  • Professional fitting: Morteza ensures every lens suits your eye shape, prescription, and wear schedule.
  • Medical oversight: Our ophthalmologist provides exams and prescription updates as needed.
  • Personal guidance: Learn proper care, insertion, and cleaning techniques.
  • Trusted brands: Acuvue, Ciba Vision, Bausch + Lomb.
  • Convenience: Order through us and pick up locally — no shipping hassles.

Contact Lens Brands We Carry

Acuvue Contact Lenses

Acuvue is one of the most popular brands worldwide, known for comfort and innovation. Patients love Acuvue’s daily disposables, toric lenses for astigmatism, and multifocal lenses. Whether you need convenience or advanced correction, Acuvue has a solution.

Ciba Vision Contact Lenses

Ciba Vision offers a range of contact lenses designed for clarity, comfort, and unique needs. Their specialty designs and cosmetic color lenses are a favorite for patients who want both function and style.

Bausch + Lomb Contact Lenses

With over a century of optical innovation, Bausch + Lomb remains a leader in vision care. Their lenses are known for sharp vision, advanced materials, and durability. From daily wear to specialty lenses, they provide reliable solutions for patients of all ages.

Types of Contact Lenses We Offer

Every patient’s eyes are unique, which is why we offer a full spectrum of lens options:

  • Daily, weekly, and monthly disposables
  • Multifocal and bifocal contact lenses for presbyopia
  • Toric lenses for astigmatism
  • Rigid gas permeable and specialty lenses
  • Tinted and cosmetic lenses for appearance enhancement
  • Custom designs for complex prescriptions

Thinking about upgrading to contacts? Start with our guide to contact lens fittings in Beverly Hills, compare daily vs monthly contact lenses, then schedule your exam.

The Contact Lens Ordering Process

We make ordering your lenses simple and stress-free:

  1. Eye exam (if needed): Our ophthalmologist provides comprehensive exams and verifies your prescription.
  2. Professional fitting: Morteza measures and fits your lenses for comfort and performance.
  3. Custom ordering: We place your order directly with Acuvue, Ciba Vision, or Bausch + Lomb.
  4. Boutique pickup: Your lenses are delivered to our Beverly Hills boutique — ready for you to collect at your convenience.

Caring for Your Contact Lenses

Proper care keeps your vision clear and your eyes healthy. At Optometric Cafe, we guide you through:

  • Safe insertion and removal techniques
  • Choosing the right cleaning solutions for your lenses
  • When and how often to replace lenses
  • Avoiding common issues such as irritation or buildup

For new wearers, we provide in-office training sessions to ensure you feel comfortable from the very first day.

Who Benefits from Our Contact Lens Services?

  • New wearers: Learn how to safely transition from glasses to contacts.
  • Busy professionals: Daily disposables and extended-wear options for convenience.
  • Specialty patients: Astigmatism, presbyopia, or complex prescriptions.
  • Style seekers: Colored or cosmetic lenses for appearance and fashion.
  • Local residents & visitors: Serving Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, Century City, and greater Los Angeles.

Why Patients Trust Optometric Cafe

  • Boutique care: Personal service from a family-owned Beverly Hills practice.
  • Experience: Morteza’s fitting expertise helps ensure the right lens and the right wear schedule.
  • Medical oversight: In-office ophthalmologist available for exams and ongoing care.
  • Trusted brands: Only lenses from globally recognized manufacturers.
  • Convenience & trust: Skip the online guesswork — rely on your local eye care team.

Ready to order your lenses? Call us at (310) 888-2848 or visit Optometric Cafe today.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

Do I need a prescription for contact lenses?

Yes. Contact lenses are medical devices, and a valid prescription is required. Our in-office ophthalmologist provides comprehensive eye exams if yours needs updating.

How long does it take to receive my lenses?

Most orders arrive within a few business days, and we’ll notify you when they are ready for boutique pickup.

Can you order colored or specialty contact lenses?

Absolutely. We carry tinted and cosmetic lenses, as well as specialty designs for astigmatism or other unique prescriptions.

Do you offer training for first-time contact lens wearers?

Yes. Morteza provides personalized training to ensure you know how to insert, remove, and care for your lenses properly.

Which areas do you serve?

We are located in Beverly Hills and serve patients from surrounding areas, including West Hollywood, Century City, and Los Angeles.

Book Your Contact Lens Fitting in Beverly Hills

Get contacts that feel great and match your lifestyle — with professional fitting and medical oversight. Learn more about what happens during a contact lens fitting or call (310) 888-2848 or book online to get started.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby. We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, The Flats, Holmby Hills, Bel-Air, Benedict Canyon, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Cheviot Hills, South Carthay, and Monte Mar Vista. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away — and always worth the visit.

title: Contact Us
description: Contact Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills to schedule eye exams, prescription glasses, contact lenses, sunglasses, and eyewear fittings.
content:
Contact Optometric Cafe

Questions, appointments, or eyewear fittings—reach us by phone, visit the shop, or use the map for directions.

  • Address
    277 South Beverly Dr
    Beverly Hills, CA 90212

    Get Directions
  • Phone
    (310) 888‑2848
  • Email
    info@optometriccafe.com
  • Hours
    Mon–Thu: 10:00 AM – 5:30 PM
    Fri: 10:00 AM – 5:00 PM
    Sat: 11:00 AM – 3:00 PM
    Sun: Closed
Call NowGeneral InquiriesOur LabSunglasses

Find Your Perfect Glasses Today

Whether you’re looking for prescription eyeglasses, stylish sunglasses, or a custom fit for your unique face shape, Optometric Cafe is here to help. Explore our handpicked selection of designer frames and let Morteza guide you to eyewear you’ll truly love.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.


Need Help With Glasses Today?

If your glasses are loose, crooked, scratched, or uncomfortable, call or visit Optometric Cafe. Many repairs and adjustments start with a quick in-person look at the frame and lenses.

“It’s always a pleasure to stop by this place in the heart of Beverly Hills and have Morteza help me with all of my optometry needs. To my delight he went above and beyond for a repair need that I had.”

– Joel Villalpando, Google review

title: Featured Reviews
description: Read featured reviews for Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills and learn why patients trust the team for eye exams, eyewear, lenses, and fittings.
content:
FEATURED REVIEWS

“Very friendly and incredibly knowledgeable! Definitely returning.”

★★★★★

– Taylor Sample, Google review

“I stopped into this storefront on a Saturday morning after an appointment in the area. I’d been wanting to get my LV sunglasses looked at to see about buffing out a scratch and tightening the arms. Morteza was assisting another customer, but warmly waved me in. After assisting the other customer, I approached the counter and filled him in on what I was looking for. He inspected my glasses, and quickly stated he could not buff out the scratch. Instead of ending there, however, he explained the reason why, as buffing would distort the lens. He then quickly adjusted the screws on the glasses to tighten them, and then cleaned them at no charge. I was so grateful for his quick assistance, professionalism and honesty! I will definitely be back and will tell my friends about this location. Thank you!”

★★★★★

– Victoria Green, Google review

“Morteza was so helpful, kind and knowledgeable. Great customer service and high quality stuff service here.”

★★★★★

– Davyd G, Google review

“Very kind and generous owners. Helped me out with when I was traveling on vacation.”

★★★★★

– Aashika Duvoor, Google review

“Excellent service: was given contacts in an emergency.”

★★★★★

– Andres Rosales, Google review

“In and out very quickly and efficiently! Took 5 minutes to fix my sunglasses.”

★★★★★

– Matt, Google review

“The absolute best customer service he fixed my client Dior glasses in 30 mins and explained all he did and made it better than it was very professional and amazing prices thank you.”

★★★★★

– kika guirguis, Google review

“I had a wonderful experience at the Optometric Cafe! I have a very high prescription and have been searching for frames that would truly work for me. After visiting so many opticians, this was the only place where I received such attentive, thoughtful care. They were incredibly kind, helpful, and meticulous with every detail. It is pricier than other places, but absolutely worth it. Highly recommend!”

★★★★★

– Polina Durneva, Google review

“Best customer service. I have been getting my eyeglasses from Morteza and Mostafa for decades now and they go above and beyond. I can’t imagine going anywhere else.”

★★★★★

– Nick Jones, Google review

“It’s always a pleasure to stop by this place in the heart of Beverly Hills and have Morteza help me with all of my optometry needs. To my delight he went above and beyond for a repair need that I had.”

★★★★★

– Joel Villalpando, Google review

“I can go on and rave about the different types of designer frames they carry that no one else does, but that is expected of a Beverly Hills boutique! I bought a pair of hand made optical frames 2 years ago from Morteza (the owner) just because I loved the way they looked and felt. I live in Pasadena and had my regular optician put lenses on them. He could not put the hinges back together correctly and I had to bring them to Morteza to adjust them.”

★★★★★

– Ardy G., Yelp review

“I love their selection of glasses here, and amazing customer service!! Would definitely recommend. I always feel like I get honest opinion too when I ask for advice on what looks good on me. They don’t just try to sell me the most expensive glasses, they tell the truth even if the better one is the least expensive. I love that.”

★★★★★

– Erin S., Yelp review

“The care and work of Morteza and Mostafa are so exceptional that I send my eyeglass prescriptions from NY to Beverly Hills… progressive lenses in a remarkably short time… You will NOT find this level of care or expertise anywhere else.”

★★★★★

– Lou Sapienza, 21 Jun 2024

“Wonderful customer service… they kindly gave me 5 lenses to last my remaining time in L.A. at no charge. If I was a local, they’d be my go-to.”

★★★★★

– Tamra Bryan, 6 Jul 2024

“Amazing collection in Beverly Hills… owner is incredibly sweet, helpful, and patient.”

★★★★★

– Riteek Boochra, 18 Jul 2024

“Needed lenses changed on a few pairs—others would send them out for a week. Optometric Cafe did it onsite in a day and a half at a fair price. High-quality work and great service.”

★★★★★

– JC V, 1 May 2024

“Most places use central labs—no personal touch for progressives. Here, Morteza handled the fitting and measurements himself; the quality was incredible.”

★★★★★

– Phil C, 4 Feb 2024

“Super friendly, fast and easy fix for my sunglasses.”

★★★★★

– Mike Lee, 30 May 2024

“Got a next-day appointment, clean office, everyone was very nice and answered all my questions. Would recommend.”

★★★★★

– Diego Ramirez, 10 May 2024

“I have a very high prescription… their technique makes my prescription beautiful. I’ve used their lab for years.”

★★★★★

– Paula Boomhower, 19 Aug 2023

“Only place able to fix my damaged sunglass frame in a couple of days; perfect outcome and affordable.”

★★★★★

– Rohit Nadkarni, 13 Aug 2023

“They do all their lab work on premises… very pleased with new glasses for night driving.”

★★★★★

– Seth Ricker, 6 May 2015

Book Your Sunglasses Fitting in Beverly Hills

Protect your eyes and upgrade your style with designer sunglasses that fit perfectly. Whether you need prescription or non-prescription lenses, we’ll help you find the right pair in our Beverly Hills boutique. Call us at (310) 888-2848 or stop by today.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

title: Glasses Repair and Adjustment in Beverly Hills
description: Need glasses repair or adjustment in Beverly Hills? Visit Optometric Cafe for frame adjustments, sunglass repair help, lens guidance, and expert fitting.
content:
If your glasses are loose, crooked, uncomfortable, scratched, or not sitting the way they should, bring them to Optometric Cafe on South Beverly Drive. We help with eyeglass adjustments, sunglass repairs, lens replacement questions, frame fitting, and practical repair guidance for prescription glasses and designer sunglasses.

Many customers visit us because they need quick, careful help from someone who understands how eyewear should fit. Morteza is especially known for expert fittings, honest advice, and careful hands-on adjustments.

Need help today? Call (310) 888-2848 or get directions to our Beverly Hills boutique.

What We Can Help With

  • Loose or crooked eyeglass frames
  • Sunglasses that need tightening or adjustment
  • Nose pad comfort and fit issues
  • Frames that slide, pinch, or sit unevenly
  • Lens replacement questions for prescription glasses or sunglasses
  • Evaluation of scratched sunglass lenses
  • Fit checks for high prescriptions, progressives, and designer frames

Honest Repair Advice

Not every scratched lens can be buffed safely. Sometimes polishing a lens can distort the optics or damage coatings. We will inspect the glasses and explain the practical options clearly, whether that means a quick adjustment, replacement lenses, or a different solution.

Because Optometric Cafe has an in-house optical workshop, we can evaluate eyewear with more context than a shop that sends every detail away.

Designer Sunglasses and Prescription Frames

We regularly help customers with premium eyewear, designer sunglasses, prescription frames, and specialty lenses. If you have a favorite pair, bring it in. We can check whether it can be adjusted, repaired, or updated with new lenses.

For related guidance, read our articles on how to care for your glasses properly, cheap sunglasses and eye protection, and prescription sunglasses before summer.

What Customers Say

“In and out very quickly and efficiently! Took 5 minutes to fix my sunglasses.”

– Matt, Google review

“The absolute best customer service he fixed my client Dior glasses in 30 mins and explained all he did and made it better than it was very professional and amazing prices thank you.”

– kika guirguis, Google review

“It’s always a pleasure to stop by this place in the heart of Beverly Hills and have Morteza help me with all of my optometry needs. To my delight he went above and beyond for a repair need that I had.”

– Joel Villalpando, Google review

Visit Optometric Cafe

Optometric Cafe is located at 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212. If your glasses need attention, stop by or call ahead at (310) 888-2848.

title: Men’s Prescription Glasses in Beverly Hills
description: Find men’s prescription glasses in Beverly Hills with designer frames, custom lenses, precise fittings, and expert eyewear guidance.
content:
MEN’S PRESCRIPTION EYE GLASSES

Men’s eyeglasses have evolved—classic shapes are reborn with modern materials, stronger construction, and cleaner lines. At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we curate a bespoke selection of men’s frames handpicked by Morteza, from timeless aviators and double brow-bar designs to minimalist rimless and bold acetate looks.

What makes us different isn’t just selection—it’s the experience. Morteza guides you to frames that suit your face shape, wardrobe, and daily routine, then we craft lenses in our own on-site lab. The process is personal, precise, and never pushy—most clients walk out with glasses they truly love.

Bespoke Frames, Handpicked by Morteza

Our men’s collection balances heritage and innovation. Explore aviator silhouettes, squared classics, double brow-bar statements, and contemporary semi-rimless styles alongside lightweight titanium and refined acetate. Because every frame on our shelves is hand-selected, you’ll find distinctive options you won’t see at run-of-the-mill retailers.

Fit matters as much as style. Frame measurements—lens width, bridge size, and temple length—determine comfort and balance. We fine-tune each choice on your face, ensuring the frame sits naturally, aligns with your pupils, and works seamlessly with your prescription.

Custom Lenses from Our On-Site Lab

Unlike shops that ship orders away, we build your lenses in our Beverly Hills lab for speed, accuracy, and quality control. From single-vision to progressives, anti-fatigue, and high-index designs, every pair is calibrated with meticulous attention to detail. Have a complex or hard-to-make prescription? That’s our specialty—precise optics, comfortable wear, and crystal-clear vision.

Finish your lenses with coatings that fit your lifestyle: anti-reflective for clarity, scratch-resistant for durability, blue-light filtering for screen time, and photochromic options that adapt to sunlight. If you split time between office and outdoors, ask about a second pair or clip-on sun lenses to simplify your day.

Modern Materials, Lasting Comfort

Titanium delivers strength with almost weightless comfort. Stainless steel and aluminum offer sleek profiles and excellent durability. Acetate brings rich color and bold presence—from matte neutrals to layered tortoise. Prefer a clean, minimalist look? Rimless and semi-rimless frames virtually disappear, especially with anti-reflective lenses.

Not sure where to start? Try a spread of silhouettes: squared rectangles to sharpen soft features, round or curved lenses to soften angles, or modern aviators for instant polish. We’ll guide the process until the fit, look, and optics are exactly right.

Precision for Face Shape & Daily Life

Your frame should work with your features and your routine. For smaller faces, we avoid oversized fronts that overwhelm proportions; for broader features, we balance width and bridge to avoid pinching. Morteza’s practical approach aligns your style preferences with real-world comfort—so your new glasses feel natural from day one.

Need task-specific solutions? Explore computer glasses for long screen sessions, sports glasses for active days, and prescription sunglasses for driving and weekends outdoors. We’re happy to help you build a small eyewear wardrobe that fits work, leisure, and travel.

Family Boutique, Not a Chain

We’re a family-owned boutique in South Beverly Hills. That means personal care, continuity, and accountability you can feel. We keep track of your prescriptions over time, adjust frames whenever you need, and make thoughtful recommendations when your lifestyle or vision changes. Many clients visit us annually to refresh lenses and explore new designs—they appreciate a familiar team that knows their preferences and fit.

Our location is convenient to Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Whether you’re updating everyday eyewear or selecting a second pair for specific tasks, we’ll make the process straightforward and enjoyable.

Timeless to Trend-Forward: Current Men’s Frame Directions

  • Worldly: Deep neutrals, subtle metal accents, and squared profiles for a confident, well-traveled look.
  • Dapper: Polished shapes that move from boardroom to evening—think crisp rectangles, slim temples, and refined detailing.
  • Intense: Architectural metal, semi-rimless fronts, and purposeful lines that project focus and intent.

Hard Prescriptions, Easy Experience

If you’ve struggled with progressives, high prescriptions, or astigmatism elsewhere, let us rebuild your confidence. Our careful measurements, lens design choices, and in-house fabrication help minimize distortion and maximize comfort. We’ll tune the frame fit, pantoscopic tilt, and optical center so the lenses perform the way they were designed.

Already wear contacts? We also fit contact lenses and often recommend a complementary pair of glasses for long screen days or evenings when you want to give your eyes a rest.

Related Prescription Glasses Guides

Compare our guides to choosing prescription glasses, designer eyewear fit, and computer glasses for digital eye strain before your fitting.

Book Your Men’s Prescription Glasses Fitting

Upgrade your vision and your style with men’s prescription glasses crafted in our on-site lab. Call (310) 888-2848 or visit our Beverly Hills boutique to get started.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

box_shadow_blur_tablet=”40px” box_shadow_spread_tablet=”0px” divienhancer_set=”none” divienhancer_hover_effect=”none” z_index_tablet=”500″] Bespoke Frames, Handpicked by Morteza Our men’s collection balances heritage and innovation. Explore aviator silhouettes, squared classics, double brow-bar statements, and contemporary semi-rimless styles alongside lightweight titanium and refined acetate. Because every frame on our shelves is hand-selected, you’ll find distinctive options you won’t see at run-of-the-mill retailers. Fit matters as much as style. Frame measurements—lens width, bridge size, and temple length—determine comfort and balance. We fine-tune each choice on your face, ensuring the frame sits naturally, aligns with your pupils, and works seamlessly with your prescription. Custom Lenses from Our On-Site Lab Unlike shops that ship orders away, we build your lenses in our Beverly Hills lab for speed, accuracy, and quality control. From single-vision to progressives, anti-fatigue, and high-index designs, every pair is calibrated with meticulous attention to detail. Have a complex or hard-to-make prescription? That’s our specialty—precise optics, comfortable wear, and crystal-clear vision. Finish your lenses with coatings that fit your lifestyle: anti-reflective for clarity, scratch-resistant for durability, blue-light filtering for screen time, and photochromic options that adapt to sunlight. If you split time between office and outdoors, ask about a second pair or clip-on sun lenses to simplify your day. Modern Materials, Lasting Comfort Titanium delivers strength with almost weightless comfort. Stainless steel and aluminum offer sleek profiles and excellent durability. Acetate brings rich color and bold presence—from matte neutrals to layered tortoise. Prefer a clean, minimalist look? Rimless and semi-rimless frames virtually disappear, especially with anti-reflective lenses. Not sure where to start? Try a spread of silhouettes: squared rectangles to sharpen soft features, round or curved lenses to soften angles, or modern aviators for instant polish. We’ll guide the process until the fit, look, and optics are exactly right. Precision for Face Shape & Daily Life Your frame should work with your features and your routine. For smaller faces, we avoid oversized fronts that overwhelm proportions; for broader features, we balance width and bridge to avoid pinching. Morteza’s practical approach aligns your style preferences with real-world comfort—so your new glasses feel natural from day one. Need task-specific solutions? Explore computer glasses for long screen sessions, sports glasses for active days, and prescription sunglasses for driving and weekends outdoors. We’re happy to help you build a small eyewear wardrobe that fits work, leisure, and travel. Family Boutique, Not a Chain We’re a family-owned boutique in South Beverly Hills. That means personal care, continuity, and accountability you can feel. We keep track of your prescriptions over time, adjust frames whenever you need, and make thoughtful recommendations when your lifestyle or vision changes. Many clients visit us annually to refresh lenses and explore new designs—they appreciate a familiar team that knows their preferences and fit. Our location is convenient to Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Whether you’re updating everyday eyewear or selecting a second pair for specific tasks, we’ll make the process straightforward and enjoyable. Timeless to Trend-Forward: Current Men’s Frame Directions Worldly: Deep neutrals, subtle metal accents, and squared profiles for a confident, well-traveled look. Dapper: Polished shapes that move from boardroom to evening—think crisp rectangles, slim temples, and refined detailing. Intense: Architectural metal, semi-rimless fronts, and purposeful lines that project focus and intent. title: Men’s Sunglasses in Beverly Hills
description: Shop men’s sunglasses in Beverly Hills with designer frames, prescription lens options, premium sun protection, and expert fittings.
content:
Men’s Sunglasses in Beverly Hills

Men’s sunglasses are more than accessories — they’re everyday essentials that combine protection and confidence. At Optometric Cafe, we’ve curated a collection of high-quality, stylish frames in our Beverly Hills boutique, each designed with durable construction and 100% UVA/UVB protection.

Whether you prefer timeless aviators, bold square frames, or minimalist modern styles, our selection helps you find sunglasses that fit your face, your lifestyle, and your personal style. With personalized guidance, you’ll leave with a pair that feels made for you.

Choosing the right pair of sunglasses involves more than picking a fashionable frame. At Optometric Cafe, we help you balance style, comfort, and protection. Every frame is carefully selected for durability, lens quality, and fit — and many of our styles can be made into prescription sunglasses in our optometry lab.

Our goal is to make finding sunglasses simple, enjoyable, and tailored to you. Instead of browsing endless rows of frames online, you’ll have the chance to try on curated options in person, with guidance from an expert who makes sure they sit comfortably and complement your look.

Protect Your Eyes with Confidence

Sun protection is non-negotiable. Men often spend significant time outdoors — driving, sports, beach days, or simply walking through Los Angeles sunshine. High-quality sunglasses should do three things:

  • Block 100% UVA and UVB rays to protect your eyes and skin.
  • Reduce glare with optional polarized lenses for comfort while driving or outdoors.
  • Provide impact-resistant strength for active lifestyles.

At Optometric Cafe, every men’s style we carry meets these standards, giving you peace of mind along with timeless design.

Not sure where you fit? That’s where our personal fitting process makes the difference. We’ll have you try different silhouettes until you find the style that feels right — and looks even better.

Prescription Sunglasses for Men

If you already wear glasses, prescription sunglasses simplify outdoor life. Whether you need single-vision lenses or progressives, we’ll customize lenses to match your prescription exactly. Options include:

  • Polarized prescription lenses to cut glare while driving.
  • Scratch-resistant coatings for everyday use.
  • Gradient tints for a stylish finish with functional comfort.
  • Custom clip-ons available for select prescription glasses.

All lenses are crafted in our in-house lab for precision and faster turnaround.

Timeless & Modern Men’s Styles

Our men’s sunglasses collection balances classic design with modern updates. You’ll find:

  • Aviators – Always versatile and masculine.
  • Wayfarer-inspired frames – Iconic, sharp, and easy to wear daily.
  • Round lenses – Minimalist and relaxed, great for square or angular features.
  • Sport frames – Secure wraparounds for outdoor activity or recreation.

No matter your preference, every pair is authentic, high-quality, and fitted to you personally in our boutique.

Need to update your prescription first? Book an eye exam at Optometric Cafe, then explore men’s sunglasses, contact lenses, and more in one convenient visit.

Serving South Beverly Hills & Nearby Neighborhoods

Located in South Beverly Hills, our boutique is just minutes from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Whether you’re visiting after work or stopping by on the weekend, we’re proud to be the local choice for personal, high-quality eyewear.

Visit us at 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212. Call (310) 888-2848 to schedule your fitting.

FAQs: Men’s Sunglasses

Do you carry prescription men’s sunglasses?
Yes. Most of our men’s designer frames can be customized with prescription lenses in our in-house lab.
Which sunglasses styles work best for men?
Aviators, square frames, and Wayfarer-inspired shapes are timeless favorites, while round and sport frames add variety.
Do you offer polarized lenses?
Yes. Polarized prescription and non-prescription options are available to reduce glare.
How do I know which sunglasses fit my face shape?
We’ll guide you through styles that balance and flatter your features during your fitting appointment.
Do you carry sport sunglasses?
Yes, we stock wraparound sport frames for active men who need comfort and durability outdoors.

Related Sunglasses Guides

Learn more about prescription sunglasses vs regular sunglasses, sports glasses and prescription sunglasses, and designer eyewear fit.

Book Your Men’s Sunglasses Fitting in Beverly Hills

Discover men’s designer sunglasses that balance performance and style. From classic aviators to modern prescription frames, we’ll help you find sunglasses that fit your face and your lifestyle. Visit our Beverly Hills boutique or call (310) 888-2848 to get started.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

Prescription Sunglasses for Men If you already wear glasses, prescription sunglasses simplify outdoor life. Whether you need single-vision lenses or progressives, we’ll customize lenses to match your prescription exactly. Options include: Polarized prescription lenses to cut glare while driving. Scratch-resistant coatings for everyday use. Gradient tints for a stylish finish with functional comfort. Custom clip-ons available for select prescription glasses. All lenses are crafted in our in-house lab for precision and faster turnaround. Timeless & Modern Men’s Styles Our men’s sunglasses collection balances classic design with modern updates. You’ll find: Aviators – Always versatile and masculine. Wayfarer-inspired frames – Iconic, sharp, and easy to wear daily. Round lenses – Minimalist and relaxed, great for square or angular features. Sport frames – Secure wraparounds for outdoor activity or recreation. No matter your preference, every pair is authentic, high-quality, and fitted to you personally in our boutique. Need to update your prescription first? Book an eye exam at Optometric Cafe, then explore men’s sunglasses, contact lenses, and more in one convenient visit. Serving South Beverly Hills & Nearby Neighborhoods Located in South Beverly Hills, our boutique is just minutes from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Whether you’re visiting after work or stopping by on the weekend, we’re proud to be the local choice for personal, high-quality eyewear. Visit us at 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212. Call (310) 888-2848 to schedule your fitting. FAQs: Men’s Sunglasses Do you carry prescription men’s sunglasses? Yes. Most of our men’s designer frames can be customized with prescription lenses in our in-house lab. Which sunglasses styles work best for men? Aviators, square frames, and Wayfarer-inspired shapes are timeless favorites, while round and sport frames add variety. Do you offer polarized lenses? Yes. Polarized prescription and non-prescription options are available to reduce glare. How do I know which sunglasses fit my face shape? We’ll guide you through styles that balance and flatter your features during your fitting appointment. Do you carry sport sunglasses? Yes, we stock wraparound sport frames for active men who need comfort and durability outdoors.
