title: Our Optometry Lab in Beverly Hills
description: Learn about the Optometric Cafe optical lab in Beverly Hills for custom eyewear, difficult prescriptions, lens guidance, adjustments, and repairs.
content:
Custom Lens & Frame Services at Our Beverly Hills Optical Lab

Optometric Cafe Has Its Own State of the Art Lab

Our in-house lab is ready to provide a variety of optical services to customize prescription eyeglasses and sunglasses. There are many different types of lenses to suit all of your eyewear needs. Optometric Cafe specializes in complicated prescriptions with decades of experience manufacturing and fitting eyewear.

Optometric Cafe can also help you to hold onto a favorite pair of quality optical frames that you can’t part with by updating your prescription, adjusting the size, or making any necessary repairs. Whether you have a vintage designer eyeglass collection or your favorite pair of reading glasses, we’re here to help.

Our in-house optical lab in Beverly Hills fabricates and fits lenses with exacting tolerances—ideal for complex prescriptions, sunglass tints/polarization, and careful frame adjustments.

Optometric Cafe Lens Design and Treatment Technology Include

Lens Types

  • Single Vision Lenses – Clear vision at one distance, ideal for reading or distance.

  • No-Line Progressives – Smooth transition between near, intermediate, and distance vision.

  • Bifocals, Trifocals, and Multifocal Lenses – Distinct segments for multiple focal points.

  • High-Index, Thinner Lenses – Lightweight option for stronger prescriptions.

  • Computer & Transition Lenses – Reduced eye strain for screen use, lenses that adapt to light.

Lens Treatments

  • Scratch-Resistant Coatings – Protect lenses from everyday wear.

  • Anti-Glare & Anti-Reflective Coatings – Improve clarity and comfort, especially at night.

  • Polarized & Tinted Lenses – Reduce glare and enhance contrast in bright conditions.

  • UV Protection – Block harmful UV rays for long-term eye health.

  • UV Sunglasses – Fashion and protection combined, available in prescription or non-prescription.

Services in Our In-House Lab

  • Custom lens crafting and precision fitting.

  • Complex prescription handling for all frame styles.

  • Lens replacement and upgrades.

  • Frame adjustments and repairs.

Related Optical Lab Guides

To plan your eyewear, read our guides to choosing prescription glasses, designer eyewear fit, and computer glasses for digital eye strain.

More About Custom Eyewear

See how the lab supports luxury designer frames, prescription sunglasses, and the Beverly Hills eyewear boutique experience.

Find Your Perfect Glasses Today

Whether you’re looking for prescription eyeglasses, stylish sunglasses, or a
custom fit for your unique face shape, Optometric Cafe is here to help.
Explore our handpicked selection of designer frames and let Morteza guide you
to eyewear you’ll truly love.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

Lens Treatments Scratch-Resistant Coatings – Protect lenses from everyday wear. Anti-Glare & Anti-Reflective Coatings – Improve clarity and comfort, especially at night. title: Optometry Services in Beverly Hills
description: Schedule optometry services in Beverly Hills, including eye exams, contact lenses, prescription glasses, sunglasses, and custom eyewear fittings.
content:
EYE EXAMS & OPTOMETRY SERVICES IN BEVERLY HILLS

Schedule your eye exam appointment today with Optometric Cafe. Call us at (310) 888-2848.

After your eye exam, we can fit you for new contact lenses or prescription glasses. We have our own optometry lab and a great selection of frames.

At Optometric Cafe, eye care is never rushed or impersonal. We’re a family-owned boutique in the heart of Beverly Hills, and every patient who walks through our doors is welcomed like a neighbor. Whether you’re scheduling your child’s first vision check, updating your prescription glasses, or simply making sure your eyes are healthy, we’re here to care for you with the same attention we’d give our own family.

Ophthalmologist by Appointment Only

For medical eye care, our trusted ophthalmologist visits by appointment only. This allows for private, one-on-one time to address conditions like glaucoma, diabetic eye disease, and prescription updates.

Walk-ins are not available for ophthalmology appointments. Please schedule directly with Morteza, who coordinates all bookings and ensures your visit is tailored to your needs.

Caring for Your Vision Over Time

Vision changes can be gradual — sometimes so subtle you hardly notice until they interfere with daily life. That’s why regular eye exams are one of the most important things you can do for your long-term health. During a visit, we look beyond just “reading the chart” to check for early signs of conditions such as glaucoma, cataracts, or macular degeneration, and we help relieve common issues like digital eye strain or allergies.

Many of our patients appreciate that an exam with us also means they can update their look — choosing from prescription glasses, contact lenses, or stylish prescription sunglasses, all fitted with precision and finished in our own optometry lab.

What to Expect at Your Exam

Your visit is thorough but never rushed. We take the time to listen, explain, and answer your questions. A typical eye exam includes:

  • Conversation & History – We start by learning about your health, lifestyle, and vision needs.
  • Visual Acuity Testing – Checking clarity of vision at all distances.
  • Refraction & Prescription – Determining the exact correction for glasses or contacts.
  • Eye Health Screening – Looking for glaucoma, cataracts, retinal conditions, and more.
  • Visual Field Testing – Assessing subtle changes in peripheral vision.
  • Results & Guidance – Morteza personally reviews your results and helps plan the next steps.

Many patients tell us they feel relieved by how comfortable and unrushed the process feels — a refreshing change from larger, corporate-style practices.

Life After the Exam

An eye exam is only the beginning of great vision care. Afterward, we’ll guide you through your options:

  • Prescription Glasses – Hand-picked frames crafted with precision in our lab.
  • Contact Lenses – Comfortable fits from trusted brands like Acuvue, Ciba Vision, and Bausch + Lomb.
  • Prescription Sunglasses – A Beverly Hills essential for driving, beach days, or afternoons outdoors.

Because we finish everything in our own optometry lab, your glasses or lenses are crafted with care and often ready faster than big-box providers.

Who We Care For

Optometric Cafe serves patients across Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, Century City, and greater Los Angeles:

  • Children & Teens – Catching vision problems early to support school and sports.
  • Adults – Keeping vision sharp for work, driving, and digital lifestyles.
  • Seniors – Ongoing care for cataracts, glaucoma, and age-related vision changes.
  • Specialty Cases – From complex prescriptions to custom lenses, we help with the tough cases too.

Why Choose Optometric Cafe?

  • A boutique atmosphere in the heart of Beverly Hills.
  • Personal care from Morteza, our licensed family optician.
  • Ophthalmologist available for advanced medical eye exams (by appointment).
  • An on-site optometry lab for faster, more precise results.
  • Exclusive eyewear collections, including luxury prescription sunglasses.
  • Warm, personal service you won’t find at chain stores or online retailers.

Find us at 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212.
Call (310) 888-2848 to book your eye exam today.

Planning your visit? Read our guides to what happens during an eye exam, how often to schedule an exam, computer glasses for digital eye strain, and contact lens fittings.

Local Eye Care Guides

Learn more about Beverly Hills eye care for families, eye care near Rodeo Drive, and how often to schedule an eye exam.

Frequently Asked Questions

How often should I have an eye exam?
Most adults benefit from exams every 1–2 years. Children and seniors may need them more often.
Do I need an appointment?
Yes, all exams are by appointment only. Please schedule with Morteza, our licensed optician.
Is the ophthalmologist available for walk-ins?
No, ophthalmology visits are by appointment only.
Can I get prescription sunglasses after my exam?
Yes. We offer a curated selection of frames that can be customized with your prescription.
Do you accept insurance?
We accept many vision plans — call us to confirm your coverage.
What conditions do you check for?
We screen for glaucoma, cataracts, macular degeneration, diabetic eye disease, and more.
How long does the exam take?
Most exams last 30–45 minutes, depending on testing and dilation needs.

Book Your Optometry Appointment in Beverly Hills

Keep your eyes healthy with a comprehensive eye exam at Optometric Cafe. Our experienced optometrist provides personalized care, including vision testing, glaucoma screening, cataract evaluation, and prescription updates. Appointments are required — no walk-ins for optometry services.
Call (310) 888-2848 or schedule your visit today at our Beverly Hills boutique.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby. We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, The Flats, Holmby Hills, Bel-Air, Benedict Canyon, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Cheviot Hills, South Carthay, and Monte Mar Vista. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away — and always worth the visit.


More Than an Eye Exam

After your exam, the right eyewear fit matters. Our Beverly Hills boutique can help with prescription glasses, sunglasses, contact lenses, lens options, and practical frame adjustments.

“Morteza was so helpful, kind and knowledgeable. Great customer service and high quality stuff service here.”

– Davyd G, Google review

Explore prescription glasses, designer sunglasses, or glasses repair and adjustments.

Optometric Cafe, eye care is never rushed or impersonal. We’re a family-owned boutique in the heart of Beverly Hills, and every patient who walks through our doors is welcomed like a neighbor. Whether you’re scheduling your child’s first vision check, updating your prescription glasses, or simply making sure your eyes are healthy, we’re here to care for you with the same attention we’d give our own family. Ophthalmologist by Appointment Only For medical eye care, our trusted ophthalmologist visits by appointment only. This allows for private, one-on-one time to address conditions like glaucoma, diabetic eye disease, and prescription updates. Walk-ins are not available for ophthalmology appointments. Please schedule directly with Morteza, who coordinates all bookings and ensures your visit is tailored to your needs. Caring for Your Vision Over Time Vision changes can be gradual — sometimes so subtle you hardly notice until they interfere with daily life. That’s why regular eye exams are one of the most important things you can do for your long-term health. During a visit, we look beyond just “reading the chart” to check for early signs of conditions such as glaucoma, cataracts, or macular degeneration, and we help relieve common issues like digital eye strain or allergies. Many of our patients appreciate that an exam with us also means they can update their look — choosing from prescription glasses, contact lenses, or stylish prescription sunglasses, all fitted with precision and finished in our own optometry lab. What to Expect at Your Exam Your visit is thorough but never rushed. We take the time to listen, explain, and answer your questions. A typical eye exam includes: Conversation & History – We start by learning about your health, lifestyle, and vision needs. Visual Acuity Testing – Checking clarity of vision at all distances. Refraction & Prescription – Determining the exact correction for glasses or contacts. Eye Health Screening – Looking for glaucoma, cataracts, retinal conditions, and more. Visual Field Testing – Assessing subtle changes in peripheral vision. Results & Guidance – Morteza personally reviews your results and helps plan the next steps. Many patients tell us they feel relieved by how comfortable and unrushed the process feels — a refreshing change from larger, corporate-style practices. Life After the Exam An eye exam is only the beginning of great vision care. Afterward, we’ll guide you through your options: Prescription Glasses – Hand-picked frames crafted with precision in our lab. Contact Lenses – Comfortable fits from trusted brands like Acuvue, Ciba Vision, and Bausch + Lomb. Prescription Sunglasses – A Beverly Hills essential for driving, beach days, or afternoons outdoors. Because we finish everything in our own optometry lab, your glasses or lenses are crafted with care and often ready faster than big-box providers. Who We Care For Optometric Cafe serves patients across Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, Century City, and greater Los Angeles: Children & Teens – Catching vision problems early to support school and sports. Adults – Keeping vision sharp for work, driving, and digital lifestyles. Seniors – Ongoing care for cataracts, glaucoma, and age-related vision changes. Specialty Cases – From complex prescriptions to custom lenses, we help with the tough cases too. Why Choose Optometric Cafe? A boutique atmosphere in the heart of Beverly Hills. Personal care from Morteza, our licensed family optician. Ophthalmologist available for advanced medical eye exams (by appointment). An on-site optometry lab for faster, more precise results. Exclusive eyewear collections, including luxury prescription sunglasses. Warm, personal service you won’t find at chain stores or online retailers. Find us at 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212. Call (310) 888-2848 to book your eye exam today. Planning your visit? Read our guides to what happens during an eye exam, how often to schedule an exam, computer glasses for digital eye strain, and contact lens fittings. Local Eye Care Guides Learn more about Beverly Hills eye care for families, eye care near Rodeo Drive, and how often to schedule an eye exam. Frequently Asked Questions How often should I have an eye exam? Most adults benefit from exams every 1–2 years. Children and seniors may need them more often. Do I need an appointment? Yes, all exams are by appointment only. Please schedule with Morteza, our licensed optician. Is the ophthalmologist available for walk-ins? No, ophthalmology visits are by appointment only. Can I get prescription sunglasses after my exam? Yes. We offer a curated selection of frames that can be customized with your prescription. Do you accept insurance? We accept many vision plans — call us to confirm your coverage. What conditions do you check for? We screen for glaucoma, cataracts, macular degeneration, diabetic eye disease, and more. How long does the exam take? Most exams last 30–45 minutes, depending on testing and dilation needs. title: Prescription Glasses
description: Find prescription glasses in Beverly Hills with personalized frame selection, custom lenses, precise fittings, and designer eyewear at Optometric Cafe.
content:
Prescription Eyeglasses in Beverly Hills

At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we provide a complete eye care experience — from precise eye exams to selecting prescription glasses that suit your lifestyle. Our boutique offers a curated selection of designer frames and advanced lens options to ensure you see clearly, comfortably, and in style.

Whether you’re choosing women’s, men’s, or children’s eyeglasses, our team helps you find frames that flatter your features and lenses that protect your vision. We also specialize in computer glasses and sports prescription glasses — tailored for work, play, and family life.

Prescription Glasses for Every Lifestyle

Clear, sharp vision is essential to daily life. At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we believe choosing prescription glasses should be as enjoyable as it is precise. As a family-owned boutique, we combine the latest lens technology with personalized care, ensuring every client feels like part of our extended family. From everyday readers to advanced progressives, we make sure your glasses improve not only your vision but also your comfort, confidence, and style.

Unlike chain stores that send orders away, Optometric Cafe has its own in-house lab. This means every pair of lenses is crafted under our direct supervision for accuracy and speed. Whether you need a rush order, advanced coatings, or a difficult prescription, our lab team has the tools and experience to get it right. Our patients appreciate knowing their glasses are not handled by a distant warehouse but right here in Beverly Hills.

Expert Care for Difficult Prescriptions

Some prescriptions are harder to fill than others. High-index lenses, progressive designs, or astigmatism corrections require precision to avoid distortion and discomfort. Our specialty is taking on these complex prescriptions and turning them into comfortable, wearable lenses that deliver flawless clarity. Patients who have been turned away by large retailers often come to us for solutions—and leave with glasses that finally work.

Morteza, our lead optician, has decades of hands-on experience with frame adjustments and lens fitting. His careful attention ensures that even the most challenging prescriptions are produced with accuracy and aligned perfectly to the wearer’s needs. For many families in Beverly Hills, Morteza has been the trusted guide for years, helping them update prescriptions and select frames season after season.

Women’s, Men’s, and Children’s Eyeglasses

We believe eyewear should be tailored for every member of the family. Our women’s eyeglasses collection highlights both elegance and comfort, with frames that enhance style while accommodating daily use. The men’s eyeglasses line offers classic, modern, and professional looks, balancing durability with refined design. For younger patients, children’s eyeglasses prioritize fit and resilience, ensuring kids can see clearly while studying, playing, or participating in sports.

Because Morteza keeps track of prescriptions for entire families, parents trust him to ensure that children’s vision needs are updated as they grow, while adults can explore new frames with confidence that their lenses will be made exactly to spec. This continuity of care is something chain stores simply cannot offer.

Frames That Fit Your Face and Personality

Your glasses should feel like they were designed just for you. At Optometric Cafe, frame selection is an art as much as a science. We stock designer frames from trusted brands, carefully chosen for their quality materials and timeless appeal. Whether you prefer rimless sophistication, bold acetate, or lightweight titanium, we’ll guide you toward styles that flatter your features and match your lifestyle.

Morteza personally helps patients try frames, adjust the fit, and refine choices until the perfect match is found. His decades of experience mean he can quickly identify which frames will sit comfortably, highlight your best features, and work seamlessly with your prescription lenses. Patients often describe the experience as transformative—walking in uncertain and walking out with glasses that feel like a natural extension of themselves.

Lenses Designed for Real Life

The lens is the true heart of every pair of glasses. Our lab creates custom lenses designed to match your lifestyle. Whether you need single-vision lenses for reading or driving, progressive lenses for smooth transitions, or computer lenses to ease digital eye strain, we match lens type and coatings to your daily habits. Anti-reflective, blue light protection, and scratch-resistant coatings are also available for long-term comfort.

Because all lenses are made in-house, we can fine-tune every element for maximum precision. Patients with high prescriptions or special needs benefit from our ability to craft custom lenses that many labs cannot produce. That level of detail ensures you’ll enjoy not just better vision but a superior wearing experience every day.

A Beverly Hills Eyeglass Boutique

Located on South Beverly Drive, Optometric Cafe has become a trusted destination for locals from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Our boutique combines the feel of a neighborhood optical shop with the advanced technology of a modern eye care center. Patients often tell us they appreciate the warmth of a family-run business while enjoying services that rival luxury eyewear houses.

We take time to build relationships, not just fill prescriptions. Families return year after year, confident that their eye health and eyewear are in trusted hands. Whether it’s your child’s first pair of glasses, an updated pair of progressives for work, or a stylish new look for weekends, Optometric Cafe makes the experience smooth, personal, and memorable.

Why Choose Optometric Cafe?

  • Family-owned boutique in Beverly Hills with a welcoming, personal touch.
  • In-house optical lab for faster turnaround and unmatched quality control.
  • Expertise in difficult and high-prescription lenses.
  • Curated selection of designer frames for women, men, and children.
  • Decades of hands-on experience from Morteza, our trusted optician.
  • Comprehensive care with continuity for families year after year.

Prescription Glasses Resources

Compare related guides before your fitting: how to choose prescription glasses, designer eyewear fit, kids prescription glasses, computer glasses for screen strain, and sports glasses and prescription sunglasses.

Beverly Hills Eyewear Guides

For more local guidance, read about the Beverly Hills eyewear boutique experience, choosing luxury designer frames, and visiting Optometric Cafe near Rodeo Drive.

Book Your Eyeglasses Fitting in Beverly Hills

Protect your eyes and upgrade your style with custom prescription eyeglasses crafted in our Beverly Hills lab. Whether you’re updating your current prescription, addressing a complex vision need, or choosing frames for the first time, we’ll guide you through every step. Call us at (310) 888-2848 or stop by our boutique today to book your eyeglasses fitting and discover why families across Beverly Hills trust Optometric Cafe for their vision care.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.


Expert Fitting Makes the Difference

Prescription glasses work best when the frame, lens design, and fit are handled carefully. Morteza is known for thoughtful adjustments and precise fitting, especially for customers who want glasses that feel right all day.

“Best customer service. I have been getting my eyeglasses from Morteza and Mostafa for decades now and they go above and beyond. I can’t imagine going anywhere else.”

– Nick Jones, Google review

Need an adjustment or help with an existing pair? Visit our glasses repair and adjustment page.

Prescription Glasses for Every Lifestyle Clear, sharp vision is essential to daily life. At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we believe choosing prescription glasses should be as enjoyable as it is precise. As a family-owned boutique, we combine the latest lens technology with personalized care, ensuring every client feels like part of our extended family. From everyday readers to advanced progressives, we make sure your glasses improve not only your vision but also your comfort, confidence, and style. Unlike chain stores that send orders away, Optometric Cafe has its own in-house lab. This means every pair of lenses is crafted under our direct supervision for accuracy and speed. Whether you need a rush order, advanced coatings, or a difficult prescription, our lab team has the tools and experience to get it right. Our patients appreciate knowing their glasses are not handled by a distant warehouse but right here in Beverly Hills. Expert Care for Difficult Prescriptions Some prescriptions are harder to fill than others. High-index lenses, progressive designs, or astigmatism corrections require precision to avoid distortion and discomfort. Our specialty is taking on these complex prescriptions and turning them into comfortable, wearable lenses that deliver flawless clarity. Patients who have been turned away by large retailers often come to us for solutions—and leave with glasses that finally work. Morteza, our lead optician, has decades of hands-on experience with frame adjustments and lens fitting. His careful attention ensures that even the most challenging prescriptions are produced with accuracy and aligned perfectly to the wearer’s needs. For many families in Beverly Hills, Morteza has been the trusted guide for years, helping them update prescriptions and select frames season after season. Men’s, and Children’s Eyeglasses We believe eyewear should be tailored for every member of the family. Our women’s eyeglasses collection highlights both elegance and comfort, with frames that enhance style while accommodating daily use. The men’s eyeglasses line offers classic, modern, and professional looks, balancing durability with refined design. For younger patients, children’s eyeglasses prioritize fit and resilience, ensuring kids can see clearly while studying, playing, or participating in sports. Because Morteza keeps track of prescriptions for entire families, parents trust him to ensure that children’s vision needs are updated as they grow, while adults can explore new frames with confidence that their lenses will be made exactly to spec. This continuity of care is something chain stores simply cannot offer. Frames That Fit Your Face and Personality Your glasses should feel like they were designed just for you. At Optometric Cafe, frame selection is an art as much as a science. We stock designer frames from trusted brands, carefully chosen for their quality materials and timeless appeal. Whether you prefer rimless sophistication, bold acetate, or lightweight titanium, we’ll guide you toward styles that flatter your features and match your lifestyle. Morteza personally helps patients try frames, adjust the fit, and refine choices until the perfect match is found. His decades of experience mean he can quickly identify which frames will sit comfortably, highlight your best features, and work seamlessly with your prescription lenses. Patients often describe the experience as transformative—walking in uncertain and walking out with glasses that feel like a natural extension of themselves. Lenses Designed for Real Life The lens is the true heart of every pair of glasses. Our lab creates custom lenses designed to match your lifestyle. Whether you need single-vision lenses for reading or driving, progressive lenses for smooth transitions, or computer lenses to ease digital eye strain, we match lens type and coatings to your daily habits. Anti-reflective, blue light protection, and scratch-resistant coatings are also available for long-term comfort. Because all lenses are made in-house, we can fine-tune every element for maximum precision. Patients with high prescriptions or special needs benefit from our ability to craft custom lenses that many labs cannot produce. That level of detail ensures you’ll enjoy not just better vision but a superior wearing experience every day. A Beverly Hills Eyeglass Boutique Located on South Beverly Drive, Optometric Cafe has become a trusted destination for locals from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Our boutique combines the feel of a neighborhood optical shop with the advanced technology of a modern eye care center. Patients often tell us they appreciate the warmth of a family-run business while enjoying services that rival luxury eyewear houses. We take time to build relationships, not just fill prescriptions. Families return year after year, confident that their eye health and eyewear are in trusted hands. Whether it’s your child’s first pair of glasses, an updated pair of progressives for work, or a stylish new look for weekends, Optometric Cafe makes the experience smooth, personal, and memorable. Why Choose Optometric Cafe? Family-owned boutique in Beverly Hills with a welcoming, personal touch. In-house optical lab for faster turnaround and unmatched quality control. Expertise in difficult and high-prescription lenses. Curated selection of designer frames for women, men, and children. Decades of hands-on experience from Morteza, our trusted optician. Comprehensive care with continuity for families year after year. title: Sports Glasses & Sunglasses in Beverly Hills
description: Get sports glasses and prescription sunglasses in Beverly Hills for active lifestyles, protective lenses, secure fits, and clearer performance.
content:
SPORTS EYE GLASSES AND SUNGLASSES

Sports demand more from your eyewear than everyday glasses. At Optometric Cafe, we provide sports glasses and prescription sports sunglasses designed for protection, comfort, and performance on the field, the court, the slopes, or the water.

With impact-resistant lenses, wraparound frames, and full UV protection, our sports eyewear collection keeps your vision clear and your eyes safe. From baseball and basketball to skiing, surfing, and cycling — we’ll help you find gear that fits your sport and your lifestyle.

EYE GLASSES, GOGGLES AND EYE PROTECTION FOR SPORTS / SPORT SUNGLASSES GIVE YOU AN EDGE

It’s no secret that outdoor and athletic activity is more popular than ever. That makes properly fitted sports eyewear essential. Everyday glasses are not designed to handle impact, movement, or intense sunlight — in fact, ordinary frames may break and cause injury during sports. Sports glasses, on the other hand, are built for safety, clarity, and stability.

At Optometric Cafe, we fit athletes of all ages with prescription sports glasses, sports sunglasses, and specialty goggles, ensuring both performance and protection. Whether you’re a weekend golfer, a youth soccer player, or a skier tackling fresh powder, we’ll guide you toward the right fit.

Why Sports Glasses Matter

More than 100,000 sports-related eye injuries occur each year in the U.S., many of them preventable with the right eyewear. Sports glasses are designed with:

  • Impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses that protect against shattering.
  • Wraparound frames that stay secure during fast movement and protect against side impact.
  • 100% UVA/UVB protection for outdoor sports, reducing long-term eye damage risk.
  • Adjustable straps and cushions for comfort and a stay-put fit during activity.

Sports Glasses vs. Regular Eyewear

Glasses made for everyday use simply don’t cut it on the playing field. Frames not built for impact may crack under pressure, and standard lenses may shatter — posing more danger than protection. Sports glasses are purpose-built to protect your eyes, enhance vision, and withstand movement and sweat.

That’s why we recommend every athlete — child or adult — begin with an eye exam. Precise prescriptions and health screenings ensure your sports glasses not only protect, but also give you the clearest possible vision advantage in your game.

Prescription Sports Glasses & Sunglasses

Many athletes need more than protection — they need correction. Our in-house lab allows us to create prescription sports glasses and sunglasses tailored to your exact needs. Options include:

  • Single-vision or progressive lenses for clear sight at all distances.
  • Polarized lenses for outdoor sports, cutting glare off water, snow, or asphalt.
  • Anti-fog and scratch-resistant coatings for durability.
  • Prescription goggles for skiing, snowboarding, and swimming.

Sports Sunglasses for Every Activity

From the diamond to the surf, sunglasses built for sports give you an edge in bright conditions. Features like tints, polarization, and wraparound designs can make the difference between a squint and a smooth play. We carry options for:

  • Field sports – Baseball, softball, soccer, and golf.
  • Water sports – Surfing, windsurfing, wakeboarding, kayaking, and jet skiing, with buoyant, fog-resistant designs.
  • Snow sports – Skiing and snowboarding, including glacier goggles for extreme UV reflection at high altitudes.
  • Cycling & running – Lightweight frames that won’t slip during endurance activity.

Personalized Fitting, Local Care

Sports eyewear only works if it fits securely and comfortably. At Optometric Cafe, we take the time to adjust frames, straps, and nose pads so your glasses stay put and perform as hard as you do. We’ll also recommend lens tints or coatings based on your specific sport and environment.

Located in South Beverly Hills, our boutique serves athletes from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. No matter where you’re coming from, you’ll find authentic care and a curated selection just minutes away.

Ready to see your sport differently? Visit Optometric Cafe for a personalized fitting of sports glasses, prescription goggles, and sunglasses. Call (310) 888-2848 to schedule your appointment today.

FAQs: Sports Glasses & Sunglasses

Why are sports glasses better than regular glasses?
They’re made of impact-resistant materials, secure frames, and UV-blocking lenses, while regular glasses may break or shatter during activity.
Can I get prescription sports glasses?
Yes. We craft prescription sports glasses and sunglasses in our in-house lab to match your exact needs.
What coatings are recommended for sports eyewear?
Anti-fog, scratch-resistant, and polarized coatings are common for durability and clear vision.
Do you carry sports eyewear for kids?
Yes. We fit children and teens with safe, durable sports glasses to protect their eyes during games and outdoor play.
What sports benefit most from specialized sunglasses?
Outdoor sports like baseball, skiing, surfing, and cycling benefit from tinted or polarized sports sunglasses that cut glare and enhance clarity.

Related Active Eyewear Guides

Learn more about sports glasses and prescription sunglasses, prescription sunglasses vs regular sunglasses, and contact lens fittings for active wearers.

Book Your Sports Sunglasses & Eyeglasses Fitting in Beverly Hills

Protect your vision and enhance your game with sports sunglasses and eyeglasses designed for impact resistance, comfort, and UV protection. Whether you need prescription sports glasses, wraparound styles, or performance sunglasses, Optometric Cafe will help you find the perfect fit for your sport. Visit our Beverly Hills boutique or call (310) 888-2848 today.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

secret that outdoor and athletic activity is more popular than ever. That makes properly fitted sports eyewear essential. Everyday glasses are not designed to handle impact, movement, or intense sunlight — in fact, ordinary frames may break and cause injury during sports. Sports glasses, on the other hand, are built for safety, clarity, and stability. At Optometric Cafe, we fit athletes of all ages with prescription sports glasses, sports sunglasses, and specialty goggles, ensuring both performance and protection. Whether you’re a weekend golfer, a youth soccer player, or a skier tackling fresh powder, we’ll guide you toward the right fit. Why Sports Glasses Matter More than 100,000 sports-related eye injuries occur each year in the U.S., many of them preventable with the right eyewear. Sports glasses are designed with: Impact-resistant polycarbonate lenses that protect against shattering. Wraparound frames that stay secure during fast movement and protect against side impact. 100% UVA/UVB protection for outdoor sports, reducing long-term eye damage risk. Adjustable straps and cushions for comfort and a stay-put fit during activity. Sports Glasses vs. Regular Eyewear Glasses made for everyday use simply don’t cut it on the playing field. Frames not built for impact may crack under pressure, and standard lenses may shatter — posing more danger than protection. Sports glasses are purpose-built to protect your eyes, enhance vision, and withstand movement and sweat. That’s why we recommend every athlete — child or adult — begin with an eye exam. Precise prescriptions and health screenings ensure your sports glasses not only protect, but also give you the clearest possible vision advantage in your game. Prescription Sports Glasses & Sunglasses Many athletes need more than protection — they need correction. Our in-house lab allows us to create prescription sports glasses and sunglasses tailored to your exact needs. Options include: Single-vision or progressive lenses for clear sight at all distances. Polarized lenses for outdoor sports, cutting glare off water, snow, or asphalt. Anti-fog and scratch-resistant coatings for durability. Prescription goggles for skiing, snowboarding, and swimming. Sports Sunglasses for Every Activity From the diamond to the surf, sunglasses built for sports give you an edge in bright conditions. Features like tints, polarization, and wraparound designs can make the difference between a squint and a smooth play. We carry options for: Field sports – Baseball, softball, soccer, and golf. Water sports – Surfing, windsurfing, wakeboarding, kayaking, and jet skiing, with buoyant, fog-resistant designs. Snow sports – Skiing and snowboarding, including glacier goggles for extreme UV reflection at high altitudes. Cycling & running – Lightweight frames that won’t slip during endurance activity. Personalized Fitting, Local Care Sports eyewear only works if it fits securely and comfortably. At Optometric Cafe, we take the time to adjust frames, straps, and nose pads so your glasses stay put and perform as hard as you do. We’ll also recommend lens tints or coatings based on your specific sport and environment. Located in South Beverly Hills, our boutique serves athletes from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. No matter where you’re coming from, you’ll find authentic care and a curated selection just minutes away. Ready to see your sport differently? Visit Optometric Cafe for a personalized fitting of sports glasses, prescription goggles, and sunglasses. Call (310) 888-2848 to schedule your appointment today. FAQs: Sports Glasses & Sunglasses Why are sports glasses better than regular glasses? They’re made of impact-resistant materials, secure frames, and UV-blocking lenses, while regular glasses may break or shatter during activity. Can I get prescription sports glasses? Yes. We craft prescription sports glasses and sunglasses in our in-house lab to match your exact needs. What coatings are recommended for sports eyewear? Anti-fog, scratch-resistant, and polarized coatings are common for durability and clear vision. Do you carry sports eyewear for kids? Yes. We fit children and teens with safe, durable sports glasses to protect their eyes during games and outdoor play. What sports benefit most from specialized sunglasses? Outdoor sports like baseball, skiing, surfing, and cycling benefit from tinted or polarized sports sunglasses that cut glare and enhance clarity. title: Prescription & Designer Sunglasses in Beverly Hills – Optometric Cafe
description: Shop prescription and designer sunglasses in Beverly Hills with expert fittings, premium lenses, and personalized eyewear guidance at Optometric Cafe.
content:
PRESCRIPTION & DESIGNER SUNGLASSES IN BEVERLY HILLS

At Optometric Cafe, we combine style, eye health, and precision optics to bring you the best sunglasses in Beverly Hills. Whether you need prescription sunglasses for crystal-clear driving or designer frames for everyday wear, we craft each pair in our own in-house lab for perfect fit and clarity.

Helpful guides: prescription sunglasses vs regular sunglasses, sports glasses and prescription sunglasses, and designer eyewear fit.

Why Choose Prescription Sunglasses?

Sunglasses aren’t just about style—they’re essential for protecting your eyes from harmful UV rays and reducing glare. Our prescription sunglasses combine accurate vision correction with advanced lens technology, so you can drive, work, and enjoy the California sun without strain.

  • Reduce glare for safer driving

  • Prevent long-term UV damage

  • Enhance contrast for sports and outdoor activities

Expert In-House Lens Crafting

Unlike many eyewear shops, we have our own optical lab right here in Beverly Hills. This gives us the precision to handle even the most complex prescriptions, and to fit your selected sunglasses with exact clarity and alignment. Whether you prefer polarized, mirrored, or high-index lenses, we ensure every pair meets our exacting standards.

Beverly Hills Sunglasses Guides

Compare related guides on where to get prescription sunglasses in Beverly Hills, prescription sunglasses vs regular sunglasses, and sports sunglasses for active lifestyles.

Book Your Sunglasses Fitting in Beverly Hills

Protect your eyes and upgrade your style with designer sunglasses that fit perfectly. Whether you need prescription or non-prescription lenses, we’ll help you find the right pair in our Beverly Hills boutique. Call us at (310) 888-2848 or stop by today.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby. We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, The Flats, Holmby Hills, Bel-Air, Benedict Canyon, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Cheviot Hills, South Carthay, and Monte Mar Vista. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away — and always worth the visit.


Sunglasses Help, Repairs, and Fitting

Already have sunglasses you love? Bring them in. We can check the fit, tighten loose arms, inspect scratched lenses, and talk through prescription sunglass or lens replacement options.

“In and out very quickly and efficiently! Took 5 minutes to fix my sunglasses.”

– Matt, Google review

Learn about glasses repair and adjustments or call (310) 888-2848.

title: Women’s Prescription Glasses in Beverly Hills
description: Shop women’s prescription glasses in Beverly Hills with designer frames, custom lenses, precise fittings, and personal styling at Optometric Cafe.
content:
Women’s Prescription Glasses in Beverly Hills

Women’s eyeglasses and frames are available in countless shapes and sizes to suit every taste and lifestyle. At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, we specialize in helping women select frames that are both flattering and functional. Whether you prefer delicate and minimalist or bold and artistic designs, our curated collection includes the latest in high-fashion prescription eyewear.

Our boutique is not a run-of-the-mill eyewear store. Every frame is hand-selected by Morteza himself — from timeless classics to fashion-forward designs you won’t find everywhere else. With decades of experience, Morteza has a unique ability to match the right frame to your face shape, personality, and style whims. Most clients leave with glasses they truly love, thanks to a warm and welcoming environment where the guidance is expert but never pushy.

Get the Look You Love

From retro cat-eye frames to sleek rimless designs, we carry a wide selection of women’s prescription glasses to match your style. Our expert staff, guided by Morteza’s personalized approach, will help you find frames that balance fashion with function. And because we maintain an in-house optical lab, even complex or hard-to-fit prescriptions are handled with precision and care.

Why UV Protection Matters for Women’s Eyewear

Ultraviolet (UV) rays from the sun can damage delicate structures of the eye, increasing the risk of cataracts, corneal damage, and eyelid skin cancers. While sunglasses are essential outdoors, many prescription eyeglasses can also be enhanced with UV-protective coatings. At Optometric Cafe, we provide lens treatments that block 99–100% of UVA and UVB rays, so your eyes remain safe while your glasses remain stylish and clear.

Frame Trends for Women

  • Rock ‘n Roll Cat Eyes: Classic feminine appeal updated with bold new materials and dramatic silhouettes.
  • Groovy: Playful, disco-era inspired frames in vibrant patterns and colors.
  • Sassy: Modern, daring styles for women who want their eyewear to make a statement.
  • Urban: Futuristic designs with cutouts, laminated plastics, and architectural details for a sophisticated edge.

Custom Lenses Made in Our Beverly Hills Lab

Unlike many retailers who send prescriptions out to third parties, Optometric Cafe proudly crafts all lenses in our own lab. This means faster turnaround, greater quality control, and the ability to handle specialized or complex prescriptions other shops may decline. From high-index lenses for strong prescriptions to progressives and anti-fatigue lenses, every pair is made with advanced precision technology under our direct supervision.

Family-Owned Care and Expertise

As a family-owned Beverly Hills boutique, Optometric Cafe offers more than eyewear — we provide continuity of care. We keep track of your prescriptions, offer personalized frame adjustments, and recommend updates when needed. Morteza’s decades of experience, paired with our commitment to service, create a trusted space where women can confidently explore eyewear options in a supportive, stylish, and friendly environment.

Related Prescription Glasses Guides

Before your fitting, review our guides to choosing prescription glasses, designer eyewear fit, and what to expect at an eye exam.

Book Your Women’s Prescription Glasses Fitting Today

Protect your eyes and elevate your style with women’s prescription glasses from Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills. Call us at (310) 888-2848 or book your fitting online today.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

rimless designs, we carry a wide selection of women’s prescription glasses to match your style. Our expert staff, guided by Morteza’s personalized approach, will help you find frames that balance fashion with function. And because we maintain an in-house optical lab, even complex or hard-to-fit prescriptions are handled with precision and care. Why UV Protection Matters for Women’s Eyewear Ultraviolet (UV) rays from the sun can damage delicate structures of the eye, increasing the risk of cataracts, corneal damage, and eyelid skin cancers. While sunglasses are essential outdoors, many prescription eyeglasses can also be enhanced with UV-protective coatings. At Optometric Cafe, we provide lens treatments that block 99–100% of UVA and UVB rays, so your eyes remain safe while your glasses remain stylish and clear. Frame Trends for Women Rock ‘n Roll Cat Eyes: Classic feminine appeal updated with bold new materials and dramatic silhouettes. Groovy: Playful, disco-era inspired frames in vibrant patterns and colors. Sassy: Modern, daring styles for women who want their eyewear to make a statement. Urban: Futuristic designs with cutouts, laminated plastics, and architectural details for a sophisticated edge. Custom Lenses Made in Our Beverly Hills Lab Unlike many retailers who send prescriptions out to third parties, Optometric Cafe proudly crafts all lenses in our own lab. This means faster turnaround, greater quality control, and the ability to handle specialized or complex prescriptions other shops may decline. From high-index lenses for strong prescriptions to progressives and anti-fatigue lenses, every pair is made with advanced precision technology under our direct supervision. title: Women’s Sunglasses in Beverly Hills
description: Shop women’s sunglasses in Beverly Hills with authentic designer styles, prescription sunglass options, and personalized fittings at Optometric Cafe.
content:
WOMEN’S SUNGLASSES IN BEVERLY HILLS

The right sunglasses don’t just protect your eyes — they showcase your style. At Optometric Cafe, our women’s collection blends authentic designer frames with the warmth of a family-owned boutique in Beverly Hills.

From classic black cat-eyes to oversized tortoise rounds, every pair is hand-selected for quality, comfort, and 100% UVA/UVB protection. With Morteza, our licensed optician, guiding your fit, you’ll find sunglasses that feel as good as they look.

Classic Fashion, Trusted Designers

From timeless black shades to seasonal colors and statement silhouettes, our women’s sunglasses collection reflects the latest fashion trends while offering options that never go out of style.

  • Cat-eye frames for a touch of elegance and retro chic.
  • Oversized round sunglasses for bold, modern looks.
  • Geometric and rectangular frames that flatter oval or round faces.
  • Sporty wraparounds for active women on the go.

We partner with exclusive designer brands to bring Beverly Hills clients eyewear you won’t find in every store. Every pair is authentic, high-quality, and chosen for durability as much as style.

Prescription Sunglasses for Everyday Elegance

Many women prefer the simplicity of combining style and clarity in one pair. Our prescription sunglasses
are available across our designer lines, crafted to match your exact vision needs. Whether single-vision or progressive lenses, our in-house optometry lab ensures your lenses are precise, polished, and ready faster than most providers.

  • Polarized prescription lenses for driving or beach days.
  • Scratch-resistant coatings for long-lasting clarity.
  • Fashion-tinted lenses in classic brown, gray, or gradient shades.
  • Custom fits for women’s prescription glasses with clip-on sun lenses.

Personalized Fitting in a Boutique Setting

At Optometric Cafe, your sunglasses experience begins with a conversation. Morteza listens to your style preferences, lifestyle needs, and vision requirements before recommending frames. Because we’re family-owned, there’s no pressure — just honest advice to help you choose sunglasses that feel like “you.”

Adjustments are made on the spot, and if you ever need fine-tuning later, we’re always here to help. It’s part of what makes our boutique stand apart from corporate chains.

Protecting Your Eyes in Style

Sunglasses are more than accessories — they’re essential protection. Our women’s styles all include 100% UVA and UVB blocking,
reducing your risk of sun-related eye issues like cataracts and macular degeneration. With options for impact-resistant lenses and polarized filters, you’ll be ready for everything from driving down Wilshire to weekends in Malibu.

Need an updated prescription first? Schedule your eye exam,
then explore women’s sunglasses, contact lenses, and more at our boutique. We’ll guide you from exam to fitting with warmth and care.

Visit Our Boutique

Located in South Beverly Hills, Optometric Cafe serves women from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, our boutique is just minutes away — and worth the visit for the personal service and selection.

Find us at 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212. Call (310) 888-2848 to book your visit.

FAQs: Women’s Sunglasses

Do you carry prescription women’s sunglasses?
Yes, most of our women’s designer frames can be customized with prescription lenses crafted in our in-house lab.
Which sunglasses styles are trending for women?
Cat-eye, oversized rounds, and slim rectangular shapes remain timeless, while geometric frames add a modern edge.
Do you offer polarized lenses?
Yes. Polarized prescription and non-prescription lenses are available across our women’s collection.
How do I know which sunglasses flatter my face shape?
Our optician, Morteza, will guide you through options that complement your features and lifestyle.
Can I bring my prescription glasses for a clip-on sun lens?
Yes, we carry stylish clip-ons and magnetic sun lenses for select frames.

Related Sunglasses Guides

Compare prescription sunglasses vs regular sunglasses, learn about active-lifestyle sunglasses, and review designer eyewear fit.

Book Your Women’s Sunglasses Fitting in Beverly Hills

Upgrade your look with women’s designer sunglasses that protect your eyes and express your style. From timeless classics to the latest fashion frames, explore our wide selection of sunglasses at Optometric Cafe. Call (310) 888-2848 to reserve your fitting.

Learn More

Serving Families Across West Los Angeles

Our boutique is located in South Beverly Hills, making us a convenient choice for families nearby.
We regularly welcome patients from Beverly Hills, Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, Optometric Cafe is just minutes away and worth the visit.

Prescription Sunglasses for Everyday Elegance Many women prefer the simplicity of combining style and clarity in one pair. Our prescription sunglasses are available across our designer lines, crafted to match your exact vision needs. Whether single-vision or progressive lenses, our in-house optometry lab ensures your lenses are precise, polished, and ready faster than most providers. Polarized prescription lenses for driving or beach days. Scratch-resistant coatings for long-lasting clarity. Fashion-tinted lenses in classic brown, gray, or gradient shades. Custom fits for women’s prescription glasses with clip-on sun lenses. Personalized Fitting in a Boutique Setting At Optometric Cafe, your sunglasses experience begins with a conversation. Morteza listens to your style preferences, lifestyle needs, and vision requirements before recommending frames. Because we’re family-owned, there’s no pressure — just honest advice to help you choose sunglasses that feel like “you.” Adjustments are made on the spot, and if you ever need fine-tuning later, we’re always here to help. It’s part of what makes our boutique stand apart from corporate chains. Protecting Your Eyes in Style Sunglasses are more than accessories — they’re essential protection. Our women’s styles all include 100% UVA and UVB blocking, reducing your risk of sun-related eye issues like cataracts and macular degeneration. With options for impact-resistant lenses and polarized filters, you’ll be ready for everything from driving down Wilshire to weekends in Malibu. Need an updated prescription first? Schedule your eye exam, then explore women’s sunglasses, contact lenses, and more at our boutique. We’ll guide you from exam to fitting with warmth and care. Visit Our Boutique Located in South Beverly Hills, Optometric Cafe serves women from Century City, Pico-Robertson, Beverlywood, Crestview, Monte Mar Vista, Cheviot Hills, and South Carthay. Wherever you’re coming from, our boutique is just minutes away — and worth the visit for the personal service and selection. Find us at 277 South Beverly Dr., Beverly Hills, CA 90212. Call (310) 888-2848 to book your visit. FAQs: Women’s Sunglasses Do you carry prescription women’s sunglasses? Yes, most of our women’s designer frames can be customized with prescription lenses crafted in our in-house lab. Which sunglasses styles are trending for women? Cat-eye, oversized rounds, and slim rectangular shapes remain timeless, while geometric frames add a modern edge. Do you offer polarized lenses? Yes. Polarized prescription and non-prescription lenses are available across our women’s collection. How do I know which sunglasses flatter my face shape? Our optician, Morteza, will guide you through options that complement your features and lifestyle. Can I bring my prescription glasses for a clip-on sun lens? Yes, we carry stylish clip-ons and magnetic sun lenses for select frames. title: Best Eyewear Boutique Experience in Beverly Hills
description: Learn what makes a great Beverly Hills eyewear boutique, from designer frame fit and prescription lenses to personal optical guidance.
content:
A great eyewear boutique experience is not only about having beautiful frames on the wall. It is about fit, prescription accuracy, honest guidance, lens quality, and the confidence that someone is paying attention to the details. In Beverly Hills, where eyewear is both practical and personal, the best optical experience should feel curated, precise, and genuinely helpful.

Optometric Cafe is a family-owned optical boutique on South Beverly Drive, serving Beverly Hills patients with eye exams, prescription glasses, designer sunglasses, contact lenses, and in-house optical lab support.

Personal Guidance Matters

The right eyewear choice is easier when an experienced optician can evaluate your prescription, frame fit, face shape, bridge comfort, lens needs, and style goals together. A frame can look great but still be wrong for your lenses or daily use. Personal guidance helps avoid that mismatch.

For more detail on fit, review our guide to designer eyewear in Beverly Hills.

A Boutique Selection Should Be Curated

More frames are not always better. A strong boutique selection should include pieces chosen for quality, materials, comfort, design, and prescription compatibility. The goal is to help patients compare strong options, not overwhelm them with rows of similar frames.

This is especially important for prescription glasses, where the frame must support the lenses as well as the patient’s style.

Lens Quality Is Part of the Experience

Great frames need great lenses. Lens material, coatings, measurements, and optical alignment all affect how glasses perform. Progressive lenses, high-index lenses, computer glasses, and prescription sunglasses each require different decisions.

Optometric Cafe’s Beverly Hills optical lab helps keep frame selection, lens production, and final fitting connected.

Eye Care and Eyewear Should Work Together

An eyewear boutique is stronger when it is connected to eye care. A current prescription, discussion of visual symptoms, and review of work, driving, reading, and screen habits can all affect the final eyewear recommendation.

If you are due for an exam, start with our guide to an eye exam in Beverly Hills or learn how often to get an eye exam.

Sunglasses Deserve the Same Attention

In Beverly Hills, sunglasses are part of daily life. The best pair should fit properly, reduce glare, protect against UV exposure, and work with your prescription when needed. Designer sunglasses can often be made prescription, but not every frame is right for every lens.

Compare options in our guide to prescription sunglasses vs regular sunglasses.

What to Look for in a Beverly Hills Eyewear Boutique

  • Personal frame guidance from an experienced optical professional
  • Careful measurements and final adjustments
  • Prescription-aware frame recommendations
  • Quality lens options for work, driving, reading, and sun
  • Support for prescription glasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses
  • A local team that can help with repairs, fit checks, and future updates

Eyewear Boutique FAQs

What makes an eyewear boutique different from a chain store?

A boutique usually offers more personal frame guidance, curated selections, careful fittings, and a stronger relationship between eyewear style and prescription needs.

Should I bring my prescription when shopping for frames?

Yes. Your prescription helps determine which frames and lenses will work best. If your prescription is outdated, schedule an exam first.

Can a boutique help with difficult prescriptions?

Yes. Experienced opticians and optical labs can help choose frames, lens materials, and measurements that better support complex prescriptions.

Related local guides: Optometric Cafe near Rodeo Drive, luxury designer frames, and prescription sunglasses in Beverly Hills.

Visit Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills

If you are looking for a Beverly Hills eyewear boutique with personal service, prescription expertise, and curated designer frames, visit Optometric Cafe on South Beverly Drive.

Contact Optometric Cafe to schedule a visit.

title: Beverly Hills Eye Care Guide for Families
description: A family eye care guide for Beverly Hills covering exams, kids glasses, contacts, sunglasses, and expert optical fitting at Optometric Cafe.
content:
Family eye care is easier when one local team understands exams, prescriptions, children’s glasses, contact lenses, sunglasses, and the practical details of fitting eyewear. In Beverly Hills, families often need eye care that works for school, work, driving, screen time, sports, and outdoor life.

Optometric Cafe serves families from its South Beverly Drive boutique. Morteza Talebi is the owner and master optician, not a doctor. His specialty is helping children, adults, and seniors choose glasses that fit properly, feel comfortable, and work with the prescription. The lenses are manufactured and finished through the shop’s own optical workshop, which gives the team hands-on control over quality and fit.

Eye Exams for Different Ages

Children, adults, and seniors have different eye care needs. Kids may need help with school vision, adults may need updates for work or driving, and older adults may need more regular monitoring for eye health changes. If you are unsure about timing, read how often to get an eye exam.

For appointment details, see what to expect during an eye exam in Beverly Hills.

Children’s Glasses That Fit and Last

Children need glasses that sit securely, feel comfortable, and hold up to school and daily activity. Morteza’s fitting experience is especially valuable for families because children may not always explain why glasses feel uncomfortable. Small adjustments can make a big difference.

Read more about kids prescription glasses.

Contacts for Teens and Adults

Contact lenses can be useful for teens, adults, sports, special events, or daily wear. They require proper fitting, training, and follow-up because contacts sit directly on the eye. Start with a contact lens fitting and compare daily vs monthly contact lenses.

Glasses, Sunglasses, and Backup Pairs

Families often need more than one type of eyewear. Everyday prescription glasses, computer glasses, prescription sunglasses, sports eyewear, and backup pairs all serve different needs. The right mix depends on the prescription and lifestyle.

Explore guides to choosing prescription glasses, computer glasses, and sports glasses and prescription sunglasses.

Why the In-House Workshop Matters for Families

When lenses are made and finished through an in-house optical workshop, the team can keep measurements, frame choice, prescription needs, and final fitting connected. This is valuable for kids, high prescriptions, progressives, computer lenses, sunglasses, and families who need reliable adjustments over time.

Family Eye Care FAQs

How often should families schedule eye exams?

Many patients schedule every one to two years, but children, seniors, contact lens wearers, and people with symptoms or medical risk factors may need exams more often.

Can kids choose their own glasses?

Yes, with guidance. Children are more likely to wear glasses they like, but the frame still needs to fit properly and support the prescription.

What does Morteza do at Optometric Cafe?

Morteza Talebi is the owner and master optician. He is not a doctor. He helps with frame selection, fitting, measurements, adjustments, and lens craftsmanship through the in-house workshop.

Related local guides: Optometric Cafe near Rodeo Drive, the eyewear boutique experience, and luxury designer frame selection.

Visit Optometric Cafe With Your Family

For family eye care, children’s glasses, prescription eyewear, contact lenses, and sunglasses in Beverly Hills, contact Optometric Cafe.

Contact Optometric Cafe to schedule a visit.

title: Beverly Hills Eyewear: Personal Service & Premium Frames at Optometric Cafe
description: Discover premium eyewear in Beverly Hills with personal frame guidance, designer glasses, custom fittings, and attentive service at Optometric Cafe.
content:
When you walk into Optometric Cafe, you’re greeted not by a sales pitch, but by Morteza — the most experienced optician in Beverly Hills. With decades of expertise and a reputation for precision, he treats every customer like family. If a frame doesn’t suit your face, he’ll tell you. If it does, you’ll leave knowing you’ve found the perfect match.

Instead of walls packed with generic brands, our Beverly Hills showroom is a carefully curated collection of designer frames and premium lenses. Whether you’re searching for:

  • Everyday prescription glasses

  • Bold sunglasses for strolling Rodeo Drive

  • Sophisticated frames for the office

…Morteza personally selects each piece to ensure quality, comfort, and style.

And when it comes to your vision, we don’t cut corners. Our on-site optical lab allows us to create custom lenses with advanced options like anti-reflective coatings, polarized filters, and high-index materials. Each pair is crafted to meet your exact prescription and fit requirements, so your glasses don’t just look great — they perform perfectly.

Whether you’re a Beverly Hills local or visiting for world-class shopping, make time to stop by Optometric Cafe. You’ll find a welcoming environment, expert guidance, and eyewear that’s as unique as you are.

Find Your Perfect Glasses Today

Whether you’re looking for prescription eyeglasses, stylish sunglasses, or a custom fit for your unique face shape, Optometric Cafe is here to help. Explore our handpicked selection of designer frames and let Morteza guide you to eyewear you’ll truly love.

title: Are Cheap Sunglasses Bad for Your Eyes? What to Know Before You Buy
description: Cheap sunglasses are not all equal. Learn why UV protection, lens quality, polarization, and proper fit matter when choosing sunglasses.
content:
Cheap sunglasses are easy to find, especially when summer starts. The problem is that a dark lens and a fashionable shape do not automatically mean the sunglasses are giving your eyes the comfort, clarity, or protection you expect.

That does not mean every inexpensive pair is harmful, and it does not mean every expensive pair is perfect. It means you should know what to look for before trusting a pair for daily driving, outdoor events, travel, or long days in the Beverly Hills sun.

Dark Lenses Are Not the Same as UV Protection

A sunglass lens can be dark without offering the level of UV protection you need. Darkness reduces visible light, but UV protection depends on the lens material and coating. If the sunglasses do not clearly indicate UV protection, they may not be the right choice for regular use.

When you shop for sunglasses, ask about UV protection first. Style matters, but protection should be the baseline.

Lens Quality Affects Comfort and Clarity

Low-quality lenses may create distortion, uneven color, or uncomfortable glare. Some people notice this quickly when driving or walking outside. Others only notice after wearing the glasses for a longer period and feeling eye fatigue or visual discomfort.

Better lenses are made with more attention to clarity, consistency, tint, coating quality, and how the lens works inside the frame.

Fit Still Matters

Even good lenses can feel wrong in a poorly fitting frame. Sunglasses that slide, pinch, sit crooked, or rest too far from your face can be distracting. They may also let in more side light than expected.

This is where an expert fitting helps. Morteza has years of experience helping customers choose and adjust frames so they feel stable, balanced, and natural. That kind of attention is hard to get from a quick online purchase.

When to Invest in Better Sunglasses

Consider upgrading if you wear sunglasses daily, drive often, need prescription lenses, have a stronger prescription, want polarized lenses, or have a designer frame you want to preserve. You may also benefit from better lenses if your current sunglasses are scratched, loose, or uncomfortable.

For many people, a better pair costs more upfront but gets worn more often because the fit and vision are better.

Related Summer Eyewear Reading

If you are preparing for summer, read our guide to prescription sunglasses in Beverly Hills. You may also want to compare prescription sunglasses vs regular sunglasses or learn how to care for your glasses properly.

Bring Your Sunglasses In

If you are not sure whether your sunglasses are worth repairing, adjusting, or replacing, bring them to Optometric Cafe. We can inspect the frame, check the fit, and talk through practical options.

title: Computer Glasses for Digital Eye Strain
description: Learn how computer glasses can help with digital eye strain, screen fatigue, headaches, glare, and workday vision comfort in Beverly Hills.
content:
Digital eye strain is common for people who spend long hours on computers, tablets, phones, or gaming screens. Symptoms can include tired eyes, headaches, blurry vision, dryness, light sensitivity, neck strain, and trouble refocusing after screen use. Computer glasses can help when they are matched to your prescription, working distance, and daily routine.

At Optometric Cafe in Beverly Hills, computer and gaming glasses are part of a practical eye care conversation. The goal is not just to add another pair of glasses, but to make screen-heavy days more comfortable and visually efficient.

What Is Digital Eye Strain?

Digital eye strain happens when the eyes work hard for long periods at a fixed screen distance. Screen brightness, glare, small text, poor posture, dry indoor air, and reduced blinking can all contribute. Even a small uncorrected prescription can feel more noticeable after hours of near work.

If symptoms are frequent, start with an eye exam. Your optometrist can check whether your current prescription is still accurate and whether your screen setup requires a different lens design.

How Computer Glasses Are Different

Computer glasses are designed for the distance between your eyes and your screen. That distance is often different from reading a book or looking across a room. A dedicated computer prescription can reduce unnecessary focusing effort and make the screen feel easier to view.

For some patients, computer glasses are single-vision lenses. For others, they may be occupational lenses, anti-fatigue lenses, or progressive-style lenses designed for desk work. The right choice depends on age, prescription, screen distance, and whether you also need to read paperwork or look across a room.

Computer Glasses vs Reading Glasses

Reading glasses are usually set for a closer distance than a computer monitor. If you use reading glasses at a desktop screen, you may lean forward or tilt your head to find the clear zone. That can lead to neck and shoulder discomfort.

Computer glasses can be measured for your actual workstation, making them more comfortable for extended screen time. Bring your approximate screen distance to your appointment so the optical team can recommend the right lens setup.

Gaming Glasses and Long Sessions

Gaming can create the same visual demands as work screens, often with longer continuous focus, fast movement, contrast changes, and reduced blinking. Gaming glasses may help with prescription clarity, glare control, and comfort during extended sessions.

For kids and teens, eye comfort should be considered alongside screen habits, breaks, and general vision checks. Families can also review kids prescription glasses if a child needs everyday correction.

Lens Features to Consider

Computer glasses may include anti-reflective coating, blue-light filtering options, anti-fatigue support, thinner lens materials, or a dedicated intermediate prescription. The most important feature is still the correct prescription for the task.

Frame fit matters too. A frame that slides, sits too low, or places the lenses incorrectly can reduce comfort. If you want a frame that also reflects your personal style, review our guide to designer eyewear fit.

Other Ways to Reduce Screen Discomfort

Glasses can help, but screen habits also matter. Adjust brightness, reduce glare, keep screens at a comfortable distance, blink intentionally, and take regular breaks. If your eyes feel dry, ask your optometrist whether dryness, contacts, environment, or medication could be contributing.

If you wear contacts, screen-related dryness can be more noticeable. A contact lens fitting can help evaluate whether a different lens material or replacement schedule would be more comfortable.

Computer Glasses FAQs

Do computer glasses really help eye strain?

They can help when digital eye strain is related to prescription needs, focusing effort, glare, or screen distance. An exam can confirm whether computer glasses are appropriate.

Are computer glasses the same as blue-light glasses?

No. Blue-light filtering is one possible lens feature. True computer glasses are designed around prescription, working distance, and visual task.

Can I use my regular glasses at the computer?

Sometimes, but not always. Everyday glasses may not be optimized for intermediate screen distance, especially if you wear progressives or reading glasses.

Should contact lens wearers use computer glasses?

Some contact lens wearers benefit from supplemental glasses for screen work, glare control, or end-of-day comfort. Your optometrist can recommend the right approach.

Get Computer Glasses in Beverly Hills

If screen time is causing tired eyes, headaches, blur, or dry-eye discomfort, Optometric Cafe can help evaluate whether computer and gaming glasses are a good fit. We can also help with eye exams, prescription glasses, contact lenses, and lens options for work and daily life.

Contact Optometric Cafe to schedule a visit in Beverly Hills.
